description: Interactive surfaces shift a little on hover: fills lighten or darken 6-10% (OKLCH lightness), picture cards raise brightness to 1.04 or drop opacity to 0.88, text links go from 70% ink to 100%, all in 200-400ms on the house curve. No movement and no scale. Used on list rows, cards and secondary buttons; the primary button may take a bigger move from another pattern. The change must be readable at a glance, so a fill step below 6% is too weak. Colour roles: ground, ink; accent appears only on the primary button.
phone: No hover on touch: the pressed state uses the shifted tint for 120ms.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict.

name: Underline wipes through
description: Link text carries an underline exactly 2px thick (accent or ink, 4px below the baseline), drawn as a background size line. On hover it retracts to the right (origin right, scaleX 1 to 0, about 375ms) and at once redraws from the left (origin left, 0 to 1, about 375ms), 750ms in all on cubic-bezier 0.645, 0.045, 0.355, 1. Keyboard focus triggers the same. Use on body links, footer link lists and inline text actions. Phone: the underline stays static.
phone: Underline stays static.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. A 2px underline is the link's own state, not a divider or hairline rule.

name: Photo row drifts sideways
description: An unpinned row of four to seven large pictures or tiles (420-560px wide, 300-420px tall, 20px radius, 24px gaps) is wider than the screen. While the section scrolls through the viewport, from entering at the bottom to leaving at the top, the whole row translates horizontally by 15-25 percent of the viewport width (about 120-250px at 1440), scrubbed with 0.1 smoothing, by transform only. Every second tile may move 12 percent faster for depth, and a second row below can drift the opposite way. The row always bleeds off both screen edges equally; it never ends inside the viewport with an uneven margin. Phone: tiles 280 x 360, drift 80px, 16px section margins.
phone: Tiles 280 x 360, drift 80px.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Pictures must be designed stills, not documentary; nothing runs into one edge only; no captions boxed on the pictures.

name: Pinned horizontal track
description: The section pins for (track width minus viewport width) of vertical scroll, about 1400-4000px for a 3000-5000px track, and vertical scroll translates a wide track left. Panels are 70-100vw statements, photographs at 640x800, or filled cards at 520x640, with 48-120px gaps. The first panel starts on the page gutter (80px at 1440) and the last ends with a gutter, never touching the right edge. A 40-56px section heading stays pinned at the top-left. Photographs drift a further 6-10% inside their clips, and each panel's one-line 18px caption wipes in by clip-path from the left when the panel is 60% visible. Colour roles: one flat ground, cards a second tone, ink contrasting, accent on the closing link.
phone: No pin: the panels stack as a vertical list with 24px gaps, or a native snap row with the next card peeking by 8vw; heading above.
houseRuleCheck: Driven by scroll alone, so no drag cue, progress bar or index counter; captions are sentence case, not small uppercase labels; the first panel of the track is on the left gutter so no row is empty on the left.

name: Track slides untilt
description: A pinned section 100svh high with a horizontal track of four or five slides, each a filled card 960 x 600 at 1440 (28px radius) holding a picture and a two-line title at 40px. The track moves left as the page scrolls, about 100svh of scroll per slide. Each slide arrives from the right scaled 1.22 and turned 9.5 degrees about its centre and settles flat and at scale 1 as it reaches the centre; leaving, it turns the other way by 4 degrees and shrinks to 0.9. Colour roles: each slide its own flat fill from the palette (two or three colours only), ink text. On a phone there is no pin: slides stack vertically, each untilting from 6 degrees to 0 as it enters, with 16px margins.
phone: No pin; slides stack and each untilts on entry.
houseRuleCheck: Scroll-driven, not a drag rail; slides keep margins and never touch an edge at rest; at most five slides; caption inside the card beside or under the picture, not on it.

name: Row steps one card
description: A pinned full-screen stage, about 60vh of scroll per item, holds a row of five to nine cards or discs, each 480-560px wide with 24px gaps, in a row wider than the screen, the active one at scale 1 and its neighbours at 0.85. Each time the scroll crosses the next item's threshold the row moves exactly one item as a timed step (ease-out-expo, about 500ms for small cards, an expo in-out of 1.2s for large ones, no overshoot); the arrow keys step it too, and the wheel is never captured: the page scrolls natively and the steps follow it. The row banks (leans 3 degrees) while travelling. The active item's title (h3, 1-3 words) and one line sit below the row and swap by mask roll. After the last item the stage releases and the page scrolls on. A pair of 48px filled arrow discs is the visible fallback. Phone: native swipe with scroll snap and no hold.
phone: Native swipe with scroll snap, no hold.
houseRuleCheck: Clean on native scroll: the steps follow scroll position, the wheel is never captured and the stage releases at both ends. Cards are filled, arrows are filled discs, no progress rail or counter.

name: Lit layer breathes
description: A large picture (1200 x 700 at 1440, 24px radius) of a scene with a lit window, lamp or screen in it, made of two registered images of the same scene: the base and a version where the lit window or lamp is brighter. The lit version sits on top at opacity 0 and breathes between 0 and 0.15 over 4.5s ease-in-out, looping, so the light seems to breathe very softly; the effect is barely visible by design. Pause when off screen. On a phone the picture runs full width minus 32px and the loop is the same; with reduced motion it rests at 0.08.
phone: Same loop at full width minus 32px; reduced motion rests at 0.08.
houseRuleCheck: Rewritten so the glow is a crossfade between two real images (a lit render or photograph), never a CSS radial gradient, box-shadow or blur glow; the scene should be a rendered or styled image, not documentary.

name: Clock colon blink
description: A live local-time readout (hours and minutes, with a place word, for example the studio's time zone) in the tabular figures of the page's own proportional face at 20-32px, sitting in a contact block, the lower corner of the hero or a footer's utility area; never in the navigation as a sentence. The colon blinks once a second on a one-step animation (opacity 1 to 0 at the half), so layout never shifts. The time is computed for a fixed time zone and can drive a state word (Open now, Back at nine) with a 10px accent dot. Ink on ground. Phone: the same at 18-20px.
phone: Same at 18-20px.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Tabular figures of the proportional face, never a monospace face; not a counter or numbering; not a tiny uppercase label; not placed in the navigation.

name: Film grain jitter
description: A fixed overlay across the whole viewport (no pointer events) carrying a pre-made monochrome noise tile (256px). Every 0.6s it steps its background position by up to 6px in a random direction with no easing, so the grain seems to crawl like film. Opacity 0.04 to 0.06 on light grounds, up to 0.08 on dark ones; the layer sits above everything and uses normal blending. Gives a printed or filmic surface to an otherwise flat page. On a phone it uses a 192px tile at 0.04 and is switched off on reduced motion or low power (a static grain remains).
phone: 192px tile at 0.04; static when reduced motion or low power.
houseRuleCheck: Texture only: no gradient, no backdrop blur, no shadow; keep opacity under 7 percent so text stays crisp and contrast holds; do not use on app screens or dense data pages.

name: Thumb stack fade cycle
description: A row of three or four slots (280 x 360 at 1440, 16px radius, 24px gaps), each holding a pile of three or four pictures at the same position. Every 3s the top picture of a slot fades out over 600ms to show the next, and the faded one goes to the back of the pile; slots are offset in phase by 0.75s so the row ripples. Colour roles: flat ground, the pictures carry the colour; one line of ink type under each slot. On a phone two slots per row at 160 x 220 with the same cycle.
phone: Two slots per row at 160 x 220, same cycle.
houseRuleCheck: Pictures styled or product, not documentary; slots separated by space, no outlines or shadows; no captions on the photographs.

name: Auto-scrolling card strip
description: A single row of 8-12 tall picture cards (260x360 at 1440, portraits, posters or product shots, 24px gap, radius 0-16px), duplicated for a seamless loop at 40-60px per second (about 40s a cycle), drifts left. The strip bleeds off both screen edges symmetrically, hard-clipped, with no fade mask. Each card may tilt 2-4 degrees (alternating) and sit 16px above or below the line in turn. It pauses on hover. A 56-88px headline in two lines at the left and one button sit above the strip. Colour roles: flat ground, the pictures bring the colour, ink for the headline.
phone: Cards 180x250, 25s loop, no tilt; with reduced motion a static native snap row.
houseRuleCheck: Strips like this often fade the edges with a gradient mask: dropped, the strip is hard-clipped. Cards are pictures only with no text boxes on them; no documentary photographs; keep the page from being only boxes.

name: Giant text ticker
description: One display phrase of 2-5 words in sentence case at 160-280px, one face, leading 1.0, repeated with a 0.5em gap in a seamless horizontal loop: the track is two identical groups translating -50% over 20-30s, linear, pausing on hover and optionally speeding up to 3x with scroll velocity. The band is 280-420px high, full-bleed on both ends, in a flat accent or ink ground with the phrase in the contrasting ink; one band per page, with 160px of clear space around it. The phrase is real content, an offer or a promise, never the brand name repeated. A second or third row moving the other way is optional (the band grows to hold them): rows of the page's own offer words (one or two words each at 140-200px), full bleed in alternating directions at different speeds (loops of 40-55s), separated by space only, at most one row in the accent; a hovered row slows down. Colour roles: band ground = accent or ink, phrase = the contrasting tone.
phone: Size 88-120px (56px when there are three rows), 18s loop; with reduced motion show one static phrase wrapped over two lines.
houseRuleCheck: Not in the footer and never a giant name or email; sentence case; type is filled, not outlined (no hairline strokes); one band per page.

name: Ticker inside a pill
description: A pill-shaped link 64px tall and 320 to 420px wide at 1440, flat accent fill, containing a clipped ticker: a phrase of at most three words with an arrow glyph, repeated, sliding left at a steady 20s per loop (linear). Type 18px medium in the ink that reads on the accent. Hover pauses it. It is the page's main call to action, placed at the end of the hero column or between two sections. On a phone it spans the width minus 32px at 56px tall with a 24s loop.
phone: Full width minus 32px, 56px tall, 24s loop.
houseRuleCheck: Phrase of three words at most, sentence case, no letter-spacing; solid fill, no outline; never placed inside the navigation bar (no sentence in the navigation).

name: Logo strip loop
description: One row of 6-10 partner marks, each set at 28-36px high in a single ink tone, 72-96px apart, sliding left in a seamless loop (two identical groups, -50% over 30-60s, linear). It pauses on hover and under reduced motion (static, wrapped to two lines). It sits inside the 1296px container, hard-clipped at the container edges, with a short 17px lead-in at the left. It needs real marks; with none, leave the row out and use another proof pattern. Colour roles: ground flat, marks in ink at 60%.
phone: Marks 24px high, 25s loop, no lead-in; with reduced motion a wrapped two-line row.
houseRuleCheck: A credit wall is banned: keep to one row of 6-10, never a grid or several rows, and not in the footer; the ends are hard-clipped, no gradient fade mask.

name: Scroll-linked strip
description: One strip of words, marks or a short phrase (a phrase at 80-160px, or marks 40px high) is wider than the container and translates sideways in proportion to scroll: x = progress x (strip width - viewport width) x 0.5. When scrolling stops it keeps drifting at about 20px per second and settles by inertia (decay 0.9). It may reverse with the scroll direction. Two or three strips are allowed, stacked 24-40px apart and alternating direction (a third at 60% of the speed); besides words, a strip may carry filled cards 280-420px wide with a picture and a one-line title, never logos. 120px of space above and below. Colour roles: ink on ground, or ground on an accent band.
phone: Strip at 70% height with a movement factor of 0.7; with reduced motion show it static in two wrapped lines.
houseRuleCheck: Never a wall of marks or a rail of logos; words in sentence case and filled, not outlined; it is not a footer element.

name: Vertical columns opposite
description: A section 100svh high with two or three columns of cards (360px wide, 24px gutters, ten cards each) drifting vertically at 30 to 45px a second in opposite directions inside a clipped window, looping seamlessly. Hovering a column pauses that column. Cards are filled (works, products or short quotes) and the headline and button sit in the free fourth column on the left, so the left is never empty. Colour roles: card fills from the palette, ink text. On a phone two columns of 164px cards, drifting at the same speeds; touch pauses a column.
phone: Two columns of 164px cards; touch pauses.
houseRuleCheck: Cards carry their own fill and no outlines; the drifting window is bounded so the page is not only boxes; the headline column keeps the left filled; no cards over photographs.

name: Bar contracts to pill
description: A top bar 72px tall with an opaque ground fill, wordmark left at 22px, links at 16px and one action button at the right. After 80px of scroll the bar fill contracts over 500ms (expo-out) into a centred floating pill 520 x 56 (28px radius) 16px from the top, filled in the ink with ground-coloured text; the wordmark fades out and the links rise 24px into place with a 40ms stagger. Scrolling back to the top restores the bar. On a phone the bar is 64px and the pill becomes a width of 100 percent minus 32px holding a menu button and one action.
phone: 64px bar; pill is full width minus 32px with a menu button and one action.
houseRuleCheck: Pill must have an opaque fill (no glass, blur or shadow) and no outline; links are single words, no sentence in the navigation; no announcement bar above it.

name: Nav gains action button
description: A bar 72px tall that is transparent over the hero: wordmark left, links centre right, and in the right slot a dropdown-style link. After 120px of scroll the bar takes a solid fill (200ms) and the right slot swaps its link for a filled action button 48px tall in the accent at 16px medium, whose label rolls up through a mask (350ms); the bar carries no bottom rule. On a phone a 64px bar with the menu button always at the right; the compact action button (40px) appears beside it after the swap.
phone: 64px bar; compact 40px action appears beside the menu button after scrolling.
houseRuleCheck: No bottom line (hairline ban): the bar separates itself from the content by its change of fill alone; no shadow is added on scroll. The idea, a content swap on scroll, does not need the line.

name: Hide down, show up
description: The top bar (72px high, 24-40px side padding) slides up by its own height (translateY(-100%)) over 360ms on the house curve when the visitor scrolls down faster than 12px per frame beyond 120px of page depth, and returns on any upward scroll of 8px. It is always visible within the first 120px, and while the menu is open or a link holds focus. Once the page is past the first screen the bar takes the solid page ground so the content beneath never shows through. Colour roles: ground, ink, accent for the one action button. Variant: the bar slides up by 150% of its height as soon as the scroll speed passes about 6px a frame and comes back 400ms after scrolling stops, as well as on any upward scroll.
phone: Same behaviour on a 56-64px bar; the menu trigger stays reachable whenever the bar is shown.
houseRuleCheck: This behaviour alone reads as the stock bar, so pair it with a navigation design that differs in shape; when shown the bar is a flat ground with no blur, hairline or shadow, and nothing sits above it.

name: Pill widens into nav
description: On load a small solid pill (56 x 40, ink fill) sits 16px from the top centre holding only the logo mark. From 200ms it widens (700ms expo-in-out) to 560px, done by about 900ms whether or not the page has finished loading, while the mark moves to the left and three one-word links and a small action button fade in; link labels roll up through a mask on hover (220ms). It stays as the fixed navigation. Colour roles: ink pill, ground-coloured text, accent for the button. On a phone the pill widens to 100 percent minus 32px with the logo and a menu button.
phone: Widens to full width minus 32px with logo and a menu button.
houseRuleCheck: An entrance, not a loader: no loading dots, it never waits for the load and never holds the hero back; solid fill, no glass, no shadow, no outline; links are single words and nothing is a sentence.

name: Lockup collapses to mark
description: At the top of the page the bar shows a large wordmark or lockup (48-72px high, left or centred, 40px from the top) with the links in a row at 17px. Once the page has scrolled 80-160px the lockup scales down to a 28-32px mark (a cross-fade to the monogram or to the wordmark's first letter in the same face, 300-400ms) and the link row folds into one trigger, either a filled 44px pill with one word or the single action button. The bar stays a flat ground. The trigger opens a full-height panel with the links at 40-72px. Colour roles: ground, ink, accent on the action button. Variant: the large version is a centred wordmark at the h3 step; on the first 120px of scroll it rolls up 12px and fades while a compact 22-24px copy fades in at the left of a 64px bar 100ms later, and everything reverses at the top. Both versions are text in the same face.
phone: The lockup starts at 28px and a trigger is always shown; no morph below 640px.
houseRuleCheck: The mark is a wordmark set in type, not a drawn logo shape; the bar is flat with no hairline, blur or shadow; the large lockup overlays the hero so the hero still fills the first screen alone.

name: Menu sheet drops
description: Tapping the menu button drops a full-height sheet (100dvh, flat fill in the ink, 28px radius on its lower corners) from above, scaling from 0.8 to 1 over 0.9s expo-out. Five links at most in display type, 44px on a phone and 96px at 1440, are split by letter and each letter rises 40px with a 50ms stagger inside its own word, after a 200ms delay. Closing reverses in 500ms. Colour roles: ink sheet, ground-coloured text. On a phone this is the main plan, with the links inset 16px from the edges and the close button at the top right.
phone: Main plan: 100dvh sheet, 44px links, 16px margins.
houseRuleCheck: Links only, no sentence; letters split for motion only, with the whole word kept in an aria-label; no divider rules between links.

name: Pill docks at bottom
description: At the top of the page the navigation is a normal bar. After the first 120px of scroll the bar fades up and out (opacity 0, 12px up, 200ms) and its action reappears as a floating pill docked at the bottom centre: 48px tall, fully rounded, filled with the ink (or the accent), 20-24px side padding, labels in the ground colour at 16px holding two or three short words (Work, Menu, Talk), sitting 24px above the bottom edge plus the safe area. It rises from 24px below at 0.9 scale into place in 420ms (cubic-bezier 0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). A second 48px disc beside it may hold the one word Top. The pill hides again (80px down) when the footer enters so it never covers the footer's actions, and returns on scroll up past the footer. The Menu word opens the full-screen sheet. Phone: the same pill at full width minus 32px, 56px tall, above the safe area.
phone: Full-width pill, 56px tall, 16px margins, above the safe area.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Solid pill, no glass or blur, no announcement bar, labels are single words, never a sentence.

name: Pill expands to panel
description: A menu pill 87 x 48 (24px radius, ink fill, a one-word label at 16px) fixed at the top right, 24px in. On a click it morphs on a critically damped spring (stiffness about 220, damping 30, roughly 600ms, no overshoot) into a rounded panel 465 x 840 (28px radius) anchored at its top right corner; the panel's contents (five links at 32px display, one action button 48px tall) fade in from 300ms with a 40ms stagger, and the label becomes Close. Colour roles: ink panel, ground-coloured text, accent on the button. On a phone the panel opens to 100 percent minus 32px wide and 100dvh minus 32px tall.
phone: Opens to full width minus 32px and 100dvh minus 32px.
houseRuleCheck: The panel is a solid filled card with no shadow, glass or outline; the trigger is a plain word in sentence case at 16px, not tiny uppercase.

name: Ink follows ground
description: A barless navigation: the logo at the left and the links at the right sit directly on the page, 24-40px from the top, with no fill and no border. Each section declares a light or dark theme, and a sentinel at the navigation's vertical centre reads which section is behind it and flips the logo and link ink (white to near-black and back) over 200-300ms. A one-word caption for the current section may sit beside the logo in 15px sentence case. Where a link overlaps a photograph the theme follows the picture's declared tone. The bar stays fixed and never hides. Colour roles: two inks swap, accent only on hover.
phone: The links collapse into a filled menu pill so legibility never depends on the picture behind; the logo flips the same way.
houseRuleCheck: The caption is one word, not a sentence; no hairline, no announcement bar above; on phone the filled trigger guarantees contrast over photographs.

name: Nav scales down
description: The wordmark (28px) and the main action button (52px tall) start at scale 1.2 at the top of the page and ease to 1 linearly over the first 720px of scroll, so the bar shrinks from 88 to 72px with them (transform-origin left for the wordmark, right for the button). There is no swap of content. On a phone the scale starts at 1.1 and ends within 400px.
phone: Scale 1.1 to 1 within 400px of scroll.
houseRuleCheck: Clean; a small, plain move on a standard bar.

name: Edge tabs slide in
description: Two or three small tabs (pills 44px tall, 15px medium labels such as Book or Shop, solid accent fills) stacked on the right at 40 percent of the viewport height, 16px in from the screen edge. They slide in from beyond the edge (translateX 120 percent to 0) 150ms after load, 450ms expo-out with an 80ms stagger, and slide out again when the menu or any modal opens, returning when it closes. On a phone they collapse into a single pill 16px from the bottom right and the others are hidden.
phone: One pill 16px from the bottom right; others hidden.
houseRuleCheck: Rewritten from tabs docked flush to the edge: they now keep a 16px inset so nothing runs into a screen edge; solid fills, no outline or shadow, no vertical tiny labels; three tabs at most.

name: Bar splits into tiles
description: At the top the navigation is one full-width ink tile 72px tall (16px radius, 16px from the screen edges) carrying the logo, the links and the action. On a scroll past 60px it splits over about 1.4s (expo-in-out) into a compact cluster of three separate tiles 64px tall, side by side with 8px gaps, each taking its own fill: a logo tile in the ground tint, a links tile in the ink and an action tile in the accent; back at the top they join again. Colours stay in the palette, at most three. On a phone the cluster is a logo tile and a menu tile at 56px with 8px gaps.
phone: Logo tile and menu tile at 56px with 8px gaps.
houseRuleCheck: Tiles are solid fills that sit side by side, never inset one inside another (no boxes in boxes), with no shadow or outline; about 1.4s so it does not feel stuck; no sentence in the navigation.

name: Columns at different speeds
description: A grid of 3 or 4 columns (3 columns of 400px with a 40px gap in the 1296px container, or 4 of 300px) in which every column translates at its own rate while the section crosses the viewport: offsets such as -120, +80 and -200px (amplitude 80-250px, alternating direction) between entry and exit, lerped at 0.08. This leaves stepped, overlapping gaps. The section carries 200px of extra padding above and below to hold the displacement. A card is a filled card with a 4:5 picture and then a 22px title and a 17px line, or the picture alone. Nothing pins. Colour roles: flat ground, cards in a tone 4% off the ground, ink contrasting, accent none.
phone: Two columns with 30-60px offsets, or one column with none; with reduced motion no movement.
houseRuleCheck: Overlapping cards never sit inside other boxes, and the page must not be only boxes: put a plain statement section above and below it; no text on photographs.

name: Cover rises and grows
description: A stage 0.9-1 viewport of scroll long. The next cover picture (full-bleed, 100svh) starts one screen below and rises into place over the current scene, linear to scroll, while scaling from 0.85 to 1 so that it grows as it covers. A second variant rises 180px while scaling from 1 to 1.1 over the scene it covers. The covered scene stays still or dims by 20 percent. The incoming cover's radius goes from 32px to 0 during the rise. An h1 headline of 2-5 words rests on the picture as plain letters in the colour that reads on it, with no box. Phone: the same, scale range 0.9 to 1.
phone: Same, scale range 0.9 to 1.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Plain type on the picture, no box; pictures designed, not documentary.

name: Floating decor drift
description: Six to twelve cut-out objects (transparent webp, 120-320px: products, produce, tools, plants, props) are scattered in the margins of a 100-160vh section around a centred content column. Each moves at its own parallax rate (-0.3 to +0.6 of scroll) and turns slowly up to 11 degrees across the section; sizes vary 3:1. Keep 60px of clearance from text and stay inside the gutters so nothing touches a screen edge. The centre column holds a 64-96px headline, a 20px line and one button on a flat ground. Two or three objects may also drift into the hero on load. Colour roles: flat ground, ink, the cut-outs bring the colour.
phone: Three or four objects at 60% size above and below the text block; with reduced motion a static layout.
houseRuleCheck: This move is often built from a mix of cut-outs, icons and line drawings: only photographic or rendered cut-outs are used, no icons, doodles or drawn shapes; no picture inside the headline.

name: Image drifts in window
description: A clipped window (overflow hidden, radius 0 or 24px, one radius per site) holds a photograph or a looping clip made 120-140% of the window height and centred. As the window crosses the viewport the picture inside shifts vertically through its spare height, about 10-18% of the window height from entry to exit (a 640px window gets 70-110px of travel), tied to scroll with a 0.08 lerp. Window sizes at 1440: full container 1296x640, or an inset 880x560 with a caption column beside it. Text never rides with the picture: a 40-56px headline or a 20px caption sits on the flat ground or on a filled card below or beside the window, not on the photograph. Use one to three windows per page, alternating the travel direction so they do not echo. 120px of clear space above and below each window. Colour roles: ground a flat page tone, ink standard, accent only on the caption link.
phone: Window becomes 4:5 at full width minus the 16-20px gutters; travel drops to 6-8% of the height; driven by scroll only; with reduced motion the picture sits still at its centre.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict when the picture is a designed or product image and not a documentary photograph; no text box on the photograph and no gradient scrim.

name: Images stream past fast
description: Six to ten images (artworks, prints, product shots, posters; 240-420px wide, mixed portrait and landscape, unframed) cross the screen faster than the text: each moves at 1.4-2.2x scroll speed, entering at the bottom and leaving at the top, while the section's single statement (64-120px, two or three lines, centred) stays at 1x between them. Images are staggered across x at about 8%, 24%, 62% and 80% of the width, avoiding the middle 30% where the statement sits, and some turn 4-8 degrees as they pass. The section runs 200-300vh. Images are flat: no shadow, no outline. Colour roles: flat ground, ink, the pictures bring the colour.
phone: Three or four images at 160-220px at the sides, speed 1.3x; with reduced motion a static scattered layout.
houseRuleCheck: No documentary photographs, no caption boxes on the images, and the statement is plain type on the ground, not on a box.

name: Layered depth scene
description: A pinned scene 100svh high with a back plate (a full-bleed render at 1.1 scale) and two or three alpha cut-out layers: a middle layer (hills, a skyline or objects, 120 percent wide) and a front layer of cut-outs along the bottom. Through about 200svh of scroll the layers rise at 0.2, 0.5 and 1.0 of the scroll speed and scale slightly; the title (one line, display type 120px) is its own layer that slides against the scroll (down by 20svh) between the middle and front layers so the front cut-outs overlap its lower edge. Colour roles: the scene supplies colour, title ink chosen for contrast, no overlay. On a phone two layers, title 56px and half the travel.
phone: Two layers, 56px title, half the travel.
houseRuleCheck: Rewritten from a drawn illustrated landscape (drawn-illustration ban) into rendered or photographed alpha cut-out layers; no documentary photographs; no gradient fade overlay; no text on boxes.

name: Sink and dim under cover
description: Panels are 100vh each, flat ground or full-bleed picture. As the next panel rises over the current one at normal scroll speed, the outgoing panel sinks (translating up to 50-60% of its height, so it moves at about 0.5x) and darkens to near-black through a flat ink overlay going from 0 to 85% opacity, while its text scales 1 to 0.94. The incoming panel has a hard straight top edge and no shadow. Panel content: a 80-140px headline at the bottom-left and one link. Three to five panels stack, about 100-120vh of scroll each. Colour roles: panels alternate ground tones, the overlay is ink, accent on each panel's link. Variant: timed steps instead of a scrub. Each panel owns about one screen of a held stage; when the scroll crosses its midpoint a 1.1s step plays (ease-in-out-expo): the current panel lifts 50% and dims to 50% while the next rises over it and its title and line rise through masks 60ms apart. Scroll position fires every step; the wheel is never captured.
phone: Sink 30%, dim 70%; with reduced motion the panels stack with no dimming.
houseRuleCheck: The dim is a flat overlay, not a gradient, and there is no shadow on the covering edge.

name: Text drifts slowly
description: Section headings and short captions (sentence case, never tiny uppercase labels) drift upward at 0.6-0.8x page speed across one to three screens while the pictures and cards beside them scroll at 1x, fading in over the first 15% and out over the last 15% of their range, so the words seem to float up through the layout. Heading sizes 80-160px, placed in a margin or a clear column so no picture ever passes over them while they are read; text never sits on a photograph. Two or three drifting texts per page. Colour roles: flat ink on ground, no blend modes.
phone: Factor 0.85, size 40-56px, no overlap with pictures; with reduced motion no drift.
houseRuleCheck: The drifting items are headlines or sentences, not labels; nothing moves across a heading while it is being read, and no picture sits inside a headline.

name: Slow layer under sheet
description: The outgoing section's background (a full-bleed image, a canvas or fixed layers) travels at 0.3-0.5 of scroll speed while the next section, a solid flat-colour sheet (radius 0, or 32px on the top corners), slides up over it at normal speed. The sheet has a min-height of 100vh and 160px of top padding. The underlay keeps full brightness, with no dimming. Its content (a 96-140px headline or a 3D scene) stays readable until covered. Colour roles: underlay brings its own colour, sheet = a flat ground with ink, accent on the sheet's first button. Variant: the underlay holds perfectly still (sticky, factor 0) for the height of the next section, a plain dark ground or one word at the display step, so the contrast of a dark held layer and a light sheet carries it; when the covering sheet is the footer it is a designed section 80-100svh tall with its own actions and links.
phone: Factor 0.6 with the same cover; with reduced motion the sheet simply scrolls.
houseRuleCheck: No shadow where the sheet overlaps and no gradient; the underlay text sits directly on the picture with no box.

name: Late word slides in
description: A hero headline of three to five words in display type (120 to 160px at 1440) over two lines. The last word is visible from the first frame, held 400px below its line in the first screen; across one screen of scroll in a pinned hero it slides up (scrubbed, eased) into the line and completes the sentence. Every word shares one face, colour and weight. On a phone the type is 56px, the word starts 160px below and runs over one screen.
phone: 56px type, word travels 160px over one screen.
houseRuleCheck: The sliding word has exactly the same face, colour, weight and style as the rest (no styled accent word); it is a real word of the sentence; the hero still fills the first screen alone.

name: Shapes fall into pile
description: When the section arrives (top at 60% of the viewport) 12-30 bodies drop from above onto a floor 40px above the section's bottom edge and settle into a heap under 2D physics (gravity 1, restitution 0.3-0.5, friction 0.4, at rest in about 3s). The bodies are real content: round-cropped photo tiles 120-200px, filled word pills (a short service or topic word at 22-28px on a solid fill, 56-72px high, in three or four palette tones) or the letters of a 200px word. The pointer can push them. A 56-88px statement, left aligned in two lines, sits above the heap on a flat ground; the section is 100vh. A static grid of the same items is the fallback for no-script and reduced motion. Colour roles: flat ground, pill fills from the palette, ink contrasting.
phone: 12-16 bodies at 70% size, floor above the safe area, no device tilt; with reduced motion show the final heap.
houseRuleCheck: The bodies must be photographs, filled word pills or letters, never drawn shapes, stickers or emoji; pills are filled cards on a flat ground with no shadow at rest.

name: Playable physics toy
description: A stage 1200-1440px wide and 560-720px tall (a full-bleed band with its own flat ground in the accent or the ink) holds 12-30 loose objects that fall, collide and stack under gravity in a physics engine at 60fps: cut-out product pictures, modelled 3D objects, or single large words. The visitor throws them (drag and release, pointer velocity carried over), or in the game variant press-and-hold drops a ball into one of three or four target cups, or a drivable object is steered with arrow keys, WASD or a thumb disc on touch. One sentence-case line of 18px at the stage's top left says what to do. The stage never captures page scroll (the wheel passes through); objects fall asleep after 3s to save power; when the stage leaves the viewport the world resets, objects returning to their pile in 600ms. Phone: 390 x 480 stage, touch drag and tap, a 56px filled disc as the thumb control.
phone: 390 x 480 stage with touch drag and a 56px thumb disc.
houseRuleCheck: Clean if the objects are cut-out pictures or modelled 3D, never drawn vector shapes. One stage, no boxes in boxes; no score counter or numbering.

name: Backdrop pans under beats
description: A pinned section: a full-bleed picture taller than the viewport by 600px pans up across the scroll behind four short text beats (eight words at most each, 56px display, left or centred, ink chosen for contrast), which fade in and out one after the other, each taking a quarter of the scrub. At the end the picture shrinks to 0.6 into an inset frame (24px radius) centred on the page ground and the pin ends. On a phone the picture is 100svh x 1.3 with a 30 percent pan and the beats are 32px.
phone: 100svh x 1.3 picture, 30 percent pan, 32px beats.
houseRuleCheck: Beats are bare type over the picture with no panels or boxes on the photograph; the picture is a styled or rendered image, not documentary; the shrink to 0.6 gives margins so nothing sticks to an edge when it ends.

name: Blur-zoom crossfade
description: A pinned stage (an inset 1200 x 700 frame with a 24px radius, or full bleed) with two or three renders stacked. Over about 120svh of scroll the old render grows from 1 to 1.2, blurs up to 7.5px and fades out while the next sharpens in from the same blur; a one-line caption at 24px crossfades (200ms) beside it. Colour roles: flat ground, the renders carry the colour. With three renders the move repeats. On a phone the same with 60 percent of the scale change and a 16px frame margin.
phone: 60 percent of the scale change, 16px frame margin.
houseRuleCheck: Blur applies to the pictures only; text stays sharp; no glass or backdrop blur; the caption sits beside the frame, not on the picture.

name: 3D card choreography
description: A pinned stage of 300svh with perspective 1200px and six cards (300 x 420, 20px radius, flat fills in two or three palette colours, a title and one line on each). Step one (first third of the scrub): the cards push back in depth and spread sideways (translateZ -400px). Step two: two cards return as a centred pair (360 x 500, 24px gap) and the others fade. Step three: the pair turns 180 and -90 degrees on the vertical axis; as they pass 80 degrees they fade out so no edge-on sliver shows, leaving the headline and button. On a phone the stage is two cards and the turn is a simple 90 to 0 flip in sequence.
phone: Two cards, sequential flips from 90 to 0 degrees.
houseRuleCheck: Cards are flat fills with type, no shadow to sell depth, no outlines; edge-on cards must fade out before they read as hairlines; six cards at most.

name: Card flies off
description: A pinned stage 100svh high with five or six cards stacked at the centre, each a filled card 560 x 380 (28px radius) with a picture or product view and a title at 32px with one line. The current card grows on arrival (0.9 to 1 over the first 30 percent of its slot), holds, then scales to 1.24, turns -14 degrees and flies up out of the frame while the next card rises from below (60svh to 0), all scrubbed, with about 100svh of scroll per card. On a phone each card is full width minus 32px and 70svh tall with a -8 degree fling. Variant: each card enters from the lower right (x +60vw, y +60vh, rotate +14 degrees), reaches the centre flat by 40% of its slot, holds and leaves toward the upper left (rotate -14 degrees) as the next one enters, overlapping by 15%, in front of a fixed 88px headline on the flat ground.
phone: Full width minus 32px cards at 70svh, -8 degree fling.
houseRuleCheck: Cards are filled, not outlined; no shadow while flying; captions sit inside the card beside or under the picture, not on it; the card leaving the top is mid-motion, not an edge-glued rest state.

name: Cards land on pile
description: A pinned stage (100svh, scroll length 3-4 viewport heights for 4-6 cards) on the page ground. Cards are 440-520px wide by 300-360px tall (portrait variant 360 x 480), 20-28px radius, each with a different flat fill from the palette (ground tint, accent, ink, two supporting tints), an h3-step title and one 16px line, no icon on top. As the section pins, each card enters in turn from below or from alternating sides (start y +110 to +400px, x +-115px, rotation +-6 to 11 degrees), travels over about a quarter of the scroll length and lands near the centre at -4 to +4 degrees alternating, offset up to 24px from the pile's middle so a loose pile builds. A card already landed gets a ground-coloured veil rising from 0 to 0.4 and 0.7 as newer cards land; the top card is straight. The section headline holds at the left at the h2 step. The stage releases after the last card has held for 0.3 viewport. Phone: cards 300 x 380, pile offset 12px, four cards at most.
phone: Cards 300 x 380, pile offset 12px, four cards at most, same pin.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. Filled cards are wanted; no outlines, no shadows at rest (separation is by fill and the veil on older cards), no icon above a title, and the headline column keeps the section from being only boxes.

name: Cards rise past word
description: A pinned stage of 300svh. A single display word (22vw, about 320px at 1440) in ink on the flat ground rises from 40svh below into the vertical centre during the first quarter. Then three cards (340 x 440, 24px radius, picture or flat fill, offset 60px horizontally from each other) rise from 120svh below, pass in front of the word and continue up and off, at different speeds (1.0, 1.2, 1.4). It works as a follow-up to the hero or a product teaser. On a phone the word is 28vw (about 105px) and the cards 220 x 300 in a single stack, 16px margins.
phone: Word at 28vw, cards 220 x 300 in one stack.
houseRuleCheck: The word is one ordinary headline word set normally, not a giant name in the footer and not a picture inside a headline; the cards are filled, cover only part of the word and carry no boxes on photographs.

name: Covers recede in depth
description: A pinned stage with six to eight covers (3:4, 360 x 480 at 1440, 12px radius) of albums, books, issues or products. The next cover rises from 40svh below to the front at scale 1 while each older cover recedes one step in depth: translateZ -120px, scale 0.88 per step, lifted 48px per step, fading to 0.1 by the fourth step; scroll maps continuously to the index and the stack wraps, so it loops. The title under the front cover (28px) crossfades in 250ms. On a phone covers are 220 x 300 with 32px recede steps.
phone: 220 x 300 covers, 32px recede steps.
houseRuleCheck: Covers are artwork (the cover is the picture); use scale and opacity, no outline or shadow, to separate layers; the loop must not trap scroll: release after two laps.

name: Giant disc rotates
description: A pinned stage of 400svh containing an invisible disc about 8000px across whose centre sits far below the viewport, so only the top rim passes through view. Three content sets ride its rim (each a headline at 64px and two cards 360 x 460), spaced 45 degrees apart; the disc turns 90 degrees and then back, so each set enters from the lower right, arcs across the screen tilting up to 12 degrees and exits to the lower left. Colour roles: flat ground, filled cards. On a phone the disc is 3000px and the sets stack one card at a time.
phone: 3000px disc, one card per set at a time.
houseRuleCheck: The disc is an invisible transform container, never drawn as a circle or ring (drawn-shape and outline bans); sets keep margins; cards carry no boxes on photographs.

name: Active list item swaps media
description: A pinned section (100vh, pin length = items x 70vh). On the left a list of four to seven items (a service, a product line, a chapter) in 40-72px words, leading 1.1, 16-24px apart, at 45% ink. The item crossing the section's vertical centre turns full ink, a typed arrow glyph hangs in the left gutter beside it, and a 19px descriptor of at most 14 words expands beneath it over 300ms. On the right a framed picture or clip (560x700, radius 0-24px) crossfades per active item over 450ms with a 24px slide. The list starts on the left gutter, so no side is empty. Colour roles: flat ground, ink and dimmed ink, accent on the closing link.
phone: No pin: each item is a name with its own 4:5 picture beneath, revealed when 50% visible.
houseRuleCheck: No index numbers on the items, no hairline separators between rows, and the dimmed ink stays at 3:1 or better.

name: Sticky media steps
description: A sticky media frame (right half, 640x720 at 1440, radius 0 or 24px, centred vertically) holds while the left column's four to six steps scroll past, each 100vh tall: a 40-56px headline and one 19px line of at most 24 words, on the flat ground with no box. At each step marker, about every 900px, the frame's content crossfades over 500ms to the next clip, scene, cut-out or interface frame, all cropped identically. The active step headline is full ink and the others rest at 45%. Colour roles: flat ground, frame filled with its own picture, ink and dimmed ink, accent only on a link in the last step.
phone: The frame becomes sticky at the top (52vh high, full width within the gutters) while the steps scroll under it as 40vh blocks; or stack media then text per step.
houseRuleCheck: Step headlines carry no numbers or counters, no hairline progress line between steps, and the frame holds a single picture with no text box on it.

name: Multi-act pinned stage
description: One long pinned track (100svh, 5-6 viewport heights, about 4,500-5,500px of scroll) driven by a single paused timeline of 15-20 time steps scrubbed to scroll, so every act shares one clock and one easing. Act one is the intro (one screen: a headline on the ground, small elements rise and fade in); act two the hero (0.6 screens: the product or picture scales from 0.7 to 1); act three a pan (the scene or a row of four to six cards moves 1,200-2,000px sideways); act four a list (three to six items rise one by one at the h3 step, each starting at the left margin); act five the outro (0.4 screens: the headline and the single action). Acts overlap by 15 percent so there is never a dead stretch of scroll, and nothing holds still for more than one screen. The ground steps between two flat colours at the act boundaries. Phone: each act becomes its own stacked section with its own simple reveal and no pin; only the pan stays pinned.
phone: Each act becomes its own stacked section; only the pan stays pinned.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. No progress bar or counter shows the acts, list rows begin at the left margin, and one such stage per page at most.

name: Scan zooms to band
description: A pinned section of 250svh. First a document or screen capture (720 x 960 portrait, in an inset filled card with a 24px radius) slides in from the right to the centre. It then zooms from 1x to 2x toward one row of its contents (transform-origin on that row). Two flat bands in the ink close from the top and bottom on that row, leaving a 96px strip visible, and a one-line note at 24px appears beside it. Finally everything shrinks into a 160px thumbnail in the corner of the next section. Colour roles: light ground, ink bands, accent on the highlighted row.
phone: Portrait card full width minus 32px, 2x zoom, bands, note beneath.
houseRuleCheck: Bands are flat fills (no gradient vignette, no glass); the scan is a real or mock product screen or document, not a documentary photograph; no outline around the card; the note is sentence case, not tiny uppercase.

name: Sheets stack over
description: A pinned work stage with four to six project sheets, each 100vw minus 48px wide and 100svh minus 48px tall (32px radius), filled in its own palette colour and holding a picture on the right 58 percent and, on the left, a title at 64px, one line at 20px and a link. Each sheet rises from the bottom over the previous one (translateY 100 percent to 0, scroll rate 1) while the sheet beneath scales to 0.94 and moves up 16px so its top edge peeks above the next. Colour roles: two or three palette colours only. On a phone sheets are full width minus 32px with the picture above the text.
phone: Full width minus 32px sheets, picture above text.
houseRuleCheck: Sheets are filled cards, not outlined; 24px margin on every side; the picture sits beside the text so no boxes sit on photographs; six sheets at most and not the only structure on the page.

name: Side-wipe panels
description: A pinned stage (100svh, 1,400-2,800px of scroll). A title (h1 step, 1-3 words) holds still at the centre of the ground. Two to four panels (cut-out pictures or flat colour panels, each 360-520px wide, full height or 60 percent height) wipe in from both sides: the left ones from the left edge, the right ones from the right (x from -267px to -62px settling a further 24px, clip inset from 100 percent to 0 on the outer edge, scale 1.05 to 1), arriving in alternating pairs staggered by 200-300ms of scroll. The panels stop 40px short of the title's width, or the title switches to the colour that reads on the panels at half progress, so it stays legible. Unpins once all panels have stopped. Phone: panels stack above and below the title and wipe vertically.
phone: Panels stack above and below the title and wipe vertically.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The title is plain type on the ground between panels, no box on a photograph; panels are cut-outs or flat fills, no outlines.

name: Stack fans to wheel
description: A pinned stage of 400svh. A stack of nine to twelve cards (220 x 300, 18px radius, pictures or fills) sits at the centre; in two steps of about one second of scroll each, the stack fans into a half circle and then into a full wheel of about 520px radius whose centre sits low in the frame. After that, further scroll spins the wheel (about 0.2 degrees per pixel) and each card tilts by up to 8 degrees according to the speed and settles back. A one-line headline sits above. On a phone the radius is 300px and the cards are 140 x 190.
phone: 300px radius, 140 x 190 cards, same two steps.
houseRuleCheck: Cards are pictures or flat fills with no outline or shadow; the wheel is cards only, with no drawn guide ring; cap the spin at two turns so the page is not trapped.

name: Word drum
description: A pinned stage of 200svh. Three words (the three things on offer) are set in display type (120px at 1440, 56px on a phone) on a 3D drum with perspective 1000px and a radius of 100 to 200px in z. As the page scrolls the drum turns word to word: the front word at full ink, the others at 40 percent opacity and 0.8 scale. As each word reaches the front its letters rise 100px and fade in (30ms stagger) while the departing word's letters rise away. One sentence at 22px beside the drum changes with each word. Colour roles: ink on a flat ground.
phone: 56px words, perspective 800px, the sentence beneath.
houseRuleCheck: All three words share one style, with no accent styling on the active word; one sentence at most; no numbering of the words; pin no longer than 200svh.

name: Zoom out to mosaic
description: A pinned stage of 250svh. At the start the camera is zoomed to 3.2x on one tile of a grid of 8 x 6 picture tiles (each 240 x 160 at final size, 8px gaps). Scroll pans and zooms out to 1x by about 1800px of scroll, revealing all 48 tiles as a full mosaic, framed with 24px margins on every side. The headline (three to five words) and one button appear under it as the pin releases. On a phone a grid of 4 x 6 portrait tiles with the same zoom.
phone: 4 x 6 portrait tiles, same zoom, 16px margins.
houseRuleCheck: Tiles are pictures with gaps, not outlined boxes; no captions or boxes on the photographs; the mosaic ends with margins on every side; styled or product pictures, not documentary; do not make it the only structure on the page.

name: Cell grid dissolve
description: A transition between two pages, never on the first load: a full-viewport grid of square cells (96px at 1440, 64px on a phone) in the dark ground colour covers the outgoing page, the route swaps, and the cells drop out (opacity 1 to 0 over 280ms) ordered by distance from a start point (the centre or the clicked link), a ripple of about 1.2px per millisecond; a handful re-cover with random delays before the layer fades out in 450ms. The whole thing takes about 1.4s and the layer is then removed, so nothing remains at rest.
phone: 64px cells, same ripple, under 1.4s.
houseRuleCheck: A route transition only, never a loader on the first visit; cells exist for under two seconds and leave no grid at rest; no gaps or lines between cells; skipped under reduced motion.

name: Badge unsquashes spinning
description: A round badge (flat accent disc 132px at 1440, 96px on a phone) that enters when its section is 30 percent in view: it starts as a sliver 12px wide and full height, then unsquashes into a full circle over 900ms on ease-out-expo, with no overshoot, while rotating through 360 degrees and sliding 32px in from its offset. Two words at 18px medium in sentence case and an arrow glyph sit in the centre. After the entry it rests still. It sits on the flat ground beside the picture. On a phone 96px, 16px from the corner.
phone: 96px disc, 16px from the corner, same entry.
houseRuleCheck: A flat disc on the plain ground, never on a photograph; text sentence case at 16px or more; no outline ring.

name: Bars grow in sequence
description: A row of 24 to 40 thin bars (6px wide, 12px gaps) forming a real waveform or level display in an interface, in a 160px tall zone on a common baseline. On entry (30 percent in view) the bars grow from 5px to their data heights with an 18ms stagger left to right, over about 700ms ease-out. In ink, with the played part in the accent if tied to playback. On a phone 24 bars at 5px.
phone: 24 bars at 5px, same stagger.
houseRuleCheck: Only as a real waveform, level meter or usage display inside a product interface (not decorative drawn shapes); no baseline hairline; no numbers on the bars; with no real data do not use.

name: Blur settle
description: The lead picture of a section (720 x 540) enters at scale 1.2, 15px blur and opacity 0 and settles to scale 1, no blur and full opacity over 1.4s expo-out; the neighbouring items (a supporting card, the button) rise from scale 0.9 with 4px blur to sharp, starting at 300ms with a 100ms stagger. Headlines and body text are never blurred: they are sharp from the start. On the first screen it runs on the picture only and is done by 1.2s. On a phone 8px blur and 1.2s.
phone: 8px blur, 1.2s.
houseRuleCheck: Blur applies only to pictures and cards entering, never to words; no glass panels or backdrop blur; the first screen's words are readable at once.

name: Colour block wipe
description: Each picture (480 x 600 at 1440) starts fully covered by a flat block in a palette colour (two colours at most, alternating). On entry (25 percent in view) the block wipes across (transform scaleX 1 to 0, origin at the right, 800ms cubic-bezier 0.77, 0, 0.18, 1) and the picture counter-scales from 1.15 to 1 over 1.1s; pictures in a row stagger by 150ms. On a phone the wipe takes 600ms.
phone: 600ms wipe, same stagger.
houseRuleCheck: The block is a transient curtain and is gone after the wipe; no coloured box rests on a photograph; no gradients.

name: Plain fade in
description: Elements fade from 0 to 1 with no movement over 400-900ms (large photographs up to 1.4s), once on load or entry at 60-80% of the viewport height; siblings may be offset by 60ms. Use it where movement would fight the layout: sticky frames, full-bleed pictures, text over a looping clip. A fade starts only after the image has decoded so there is no flash. Colour roles: none.
phone: Same at 300-500ms; with reduced motion show at once.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict.

name: Fade-rise stagger
description: Blocks enter once as their top crosses 85% of the viewport height: each rises 24-48px (up to 80px for a large block) while opacity goes 0 to 1 over 0.7-0.9s, ease-out-expo (0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). Siblings in a group stagger by 70-120ms in reading order, at most 8 per group so the last is done before the next group starts. A group is a row of cards, a heading with its sub, or a list. Do not animate paragraphs over 40 words piece by piece, and do not animate the hero, which is drawn in full by the load. Elements start at translateY plus opacity 0 only when scripts are running, so with scripts off everything is visible. Colour roles: none, motion only. The page uses it on cards and headings, not on every line.
phone: Same mechanism with 20-24px of rise, 60ms stagger and a trigger at 90% of the height; with reduced motion use a plain opacity fade or nothing.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. It is the default entrance on every generated page, so use it for cards and headings only and let the special moves carry the rest.

name: Footer revealed beneath
description: The footer is fixed to the bottom (position fixed, below the page in z-order, at most 100vh tall) and the page body sits above it with a bottom margin equal to the footer height. Reaching the end lifts the last section away to uncover the footer, while the footer's content eases up 8-12% and a ground-tone overlay above it fades from 40% to 0. The footer is a designed section on a flat contrast ground: a 56-96px sentence-case call to action, one filled button, link groups in a four-column grid at 19px, and a 15px legal line. Colour roles: footer ground = ink tone or accent, text in the opposite tone, button in the accent.
phone: The footer is an ordinary section after the last block, with at most a 40px lift on entry; with reduced motion no lift.
houseRuleCheck: The footer is a designed section with a call to action and clear link groups; no giant name or email and no credit wall; the overlay is a flat tone fade, not a gradient.

name: Object spins in
description: A pinned story of three scenes (100svh each). The lead object of each scene (a product glyph, an app icon or a rendered object, about 160px) enters spinning from -45 degrees while growing from 0.57 to 1 over 600ms; when the next scene starts it reverses (turns +45 degrees, shrinks to 0.57 and fades) as the next scene's object arrives. Beside it a headline at 56px and one line at 20px. Colour roles: flat ground, the object carries the colour. On a phone the object is 112px stacked above the text.
phone: 112px object above the text, same entry.
houseRuleCheck: The spinning mark must be a product glyph, app icon or rendered object standing on its own, never an icon on top of a card (icon-topped cards) and no line icons in circles; no emoji.

name: Pill expands
description: A small floating chip, a solid pill 50 x 30px in the ink or the accent, sits at a fixed place (bottom right 24px from both edges, or low centre of the hero) and grows to its working size, 230-330px wide and 44-52px tall with a fully rounded end, over 500-600ms (expo-out, width first, height 80ms later). Its label, 2-4 words at 16px sentence case in the ground colour, fades in from 0 over 250ms starting at 40 percent of the growth. A short second line may fade in beside it 300ms later. Trigger: page load after the hero's own entrance (1.0-1.6s), or scrubbed over the first 700px of scroll (opacity 0.2 to 1, width 211 to 329px). It then stays fixed and nudges 4px wider on hover. Use it for the one primary action (Book a visit, Start free). Phone: the pill grows from the centre to 280 x 48, 16px above the bottom edge plus the safe area.
phone: Grows from the centre to 280 x 48, 16px above the bottom edge.
houseRuleCheck: Clean when solid: built as a glass pill it would break the glass ban, so it is a flat fill. It carries one action in 2-4 words, so it is not an announcement bar or a sentence.

name: Rise and stay tilted
description: Two filled cards (380 x 500 at 1440, 24px radius, two palette colours, each with a picture or a short line) rise from 300px below with opacity 0 to 1 over 600ms expo-out and a 150ms stagger when the section is 25 percent in view. They settle at opposite tilts (-4 and 3 degrees), the right card 40px lower, overlapping the centre by about 24px, and stay tilted; on hover a card straightens to 0 in 250ms. On a phone the cards stack at 16px margins, tilted +-2 degrees, each full width minus 48px.
phone: Stacked, full width minus 48px, tilted 2 degrees.
houseRuleCheck: Cards are filled and unoutlined with no shadows; overlap of 24px only, so no boxes in boxes; keep text off photographs.

name: Scrubbed fade-rise
description: Elements rise 24-120px and fade in tied to scroll position, not to a timer: the value runs from 0 when the element's top is at 90% of the viewport to 1 at 55%, smoothed by a 0.1 lerp and reversing on the way out. It suits single large things: a photograph (which may also scale 0.94 to 1) or a statement of up to 20 words at 48-72px. Rows of cards use the timed stagger instead, so scrubbing and staggering never meet on one block. Colour roles: none. Because the position is the timeline, the page feels physical when scrolled slowly and quick when flicked.
phone: Rise 20-40px over the range 90% to 65%; with reduced motion no movement, the element is simply visible.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict.

name: Slide in from side
description: A photo-and-paragraph entrance. When the block's top reaches 85% of the viewport height, the photo (a 5:4 frame about 620x496 at 1440, square or 12px corners) travels its own full width in from the viewport edge (translateX 100% to 0, 1.0s, ease-out-expo) inside a section with overflow clipped, so nothing shows outside the page. 200ms later the paragraph (22px, 40 characters per line, at most three lines) rises 24px and fades in over 0.7s. Alternate the entry edge from block to block (right, then left, then right) and put the photo on the matching side so no row is empty at the left. Ground a flat tint, ink near-black, no accent. One block per screen with 160px of space above and below. Plays once on entry, no scrub.
phone: Photo full width inside 20px gutters slides only 40px (not 100%) with a fade; the paragraph sits under it at 18px and rises 16px; reduced motion: fade only.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. The paragraph sits beside or under the photo, never on it; use designed or generated imagery, not documentary photographs.

name: Staggered content swap
description: The choreography for changing steps (tabs, rotating quotes, pinned steps), not a first reveal. A panel holds 4 to 8 child blocks (title, text, figure, link). On a step change the outgoing children leave first: translateY -28px (or x -100px for a sideways step) while fading to 0, 280ms ease-in, 40ms apart, top block first. The incoming children then enter from translateY 28px (x +60px sideways) to 0, 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), 60ms apart, starting when the exit is 60% done so the two sets overlap. Panels stack in one grid cell so the height never jumps; interrupting a swap restarts from the current values. Colour roles: no colour change, ink on the section ground. Under reduced motion swap with a 150ms fade.
phone: Same, travel cut to 16px and stagger to 30ms; tabs wrap to two lines of filled chips.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict.

name: Stepped receipt feed
description: A tall filled panel (about 360x520 at 1440, 12px corners, paper-white fill on a flat tinted ground) holding a short summary such as an order, an itinerary, a price list or a change list, feeds out of a flat ink slot bar (400x20, flush to the panel's top) in six hard steps, like a printer receipt: clip-path height jumps 1/6 at a time with steps(6, end) over 1.2s, triggered when the slot reaches 70% of the viewport height. Inside, each line is a name on the left and a value on the right in the body face at 20px, line spacing 14px, separated by space alone; the final line (the total) is 28px and the only place the accent appears, as a flat pill fill behind the value. Set in the sans or serif of the page, never a monospace. Rests static after the feed. Phone: panel full width inside 20px gutters, same six steps, 0.9s.
phone: Panel full width inside 20px gutters; the six steps keep, 0.9s total; reduced motion shows the finished panel.
houseRuleCheck: The receipt cue comes from the stepped timing only: no monospace type, no dotted or hairline rules between lines (use spacing), no zigzag torn edge drawn, no shadow. The slot is a flat filled bar, not an outlined box.

name: Untilt settle
description: A row or grid of 3-4 tiles (each 4:5, about 400x500 at 1440, 12px corners, 24px gaps; photographs or flat-filled cards) arrives tilted and settles flat. As each tile crosses from 90% to 55% of the viewport height, its rotateZ runs from 5.7deg to 0 (alternate the sign so neighbours lean opposite ways), its scale from 1.02 to 1.0, transform-origin at the bottom centre, scrubbed with 0.3s smoothing. The end state is dead flat so the grid reads as aligned and calm; photos stay sharp, no blur, no opacity change. Ground flat tint; the section clips overflow because a tilted tile pokes out by about 25px. Phone: single column, tilt 3.5deg, one tile per screen.
phone: Single column inside 20px gutters; tilt 3.5deg, scale 1.02 to 1.0, one tile per screen; reduced motion: no tilt.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. No frames, shadows or overlays on the photographs; tiles are filled or photographic, never outlined.

name: Camera rides to the next room
description: One fixed full-viewport WebGL canvas holds 3-5 modelled rooms or objects (a product on a plinth, a building volume, a stage set), each standing for one section, laid out along a spline. A nav link or next control triggers a camera ride along a Catmull-Rom curve from room to room (1.8s, ease-in-out cubic, 4% field-of-view breathe at mid-flight). A flat ground-colour transition plane takes the progress: the outgoing DOM text fades in the first 30%, the incoming text rises through a mask in the last 30%. Text is DOM over the canvas: headline 72-96px, a 20px sub, at most one filled pill. Materials are flat or unlit toon (no gradient, no soft shadow); the fog is the page ground colour; ink is the text, one accent sits on a single object per room. Keep the URL in sync (history pushState) so rooms are deep links.
phone: Same camera path with the canvas DPR capped at 1.5; text 36-44px bottom-aligned, pill full width; without WebGL, reduced motion or data saver, swap to a crossfade between static renders of each room.
houseRuleCheck: Rooms must be modelled objects that stand for the subject, not floating abstract primitives or drawn shapes; flat shading only (no gradient), no shadows at rest, no glass materials.

name: Image flies between pages
description: An index of 6-12 project thumbnails (3:2, about 420x280 at 1440, 12px corners, 24px gaps) leads to detail pages. On click the thumbnail's rectangle is measured, the rest of the grid fades out in 250ms, and the same image element animates (FLIP, or the view-transitions API) to the detail hero frame (1392x680 under the nav) in 0.9s ease-in-out-expo. During the flight the picture drifts inside its frame (translateY 8% to 0) so it seems to slide within a window. After landing, the title (96px) rises through a mask in 0.6s and the body fades up. Back reverses the flight. Ground flat tint, ink near-black. Phone: frame full width at 4:3.
phone: Thumbnails in one column; the flight lands in a full-width 4:3 frame; reduced motion: crossfade.
houseRuleCheck: No colour split on the flying picture (RGB ghosts are a house no); nothing is outlined or shadowed; use designed or generated imagery.

name: Iris mask reveal
description: A route or view transition. The next view sits above the current one in a fixed layer and is revealed through a circular clip: clip-path circle(0 at X Y) to circle(150% at X Y) over 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.76,0,0.24,1), where X Y is the click point (or the top-right corner for a menu). Optional noise edge: use a canvas mask whose rim is displaced by low-frequency noise (about 40px wobble) instead of a perfect circle. Both views keep their own grounds and the circle has no border. Under reduced motion crossfade over 300ms.
phone: Origin at the tap point; 0.9s.
houseRuleCheck: No outline on the circle (no hairline) and no gradient edge: it is a mask between two full views, not a drawn shape on the page; never a porthole gate held before the page.

name: Route swap crossfade
description: Internal navigation and modal openings swap content with a crossfade: the outgoing content fades to 0 over 240-320ms while the incoming fades up from 0 over 320-480ms, overlapping by about 100ms; the page returns to the top, and persistent parts (navigation, the sound toggle) stay in place. An optional 16px rise on the incoming content. A page-swap script or the browser's view-transition support does the work, with a plain page load as the fallback. Modals open with the same fade plus a 0.98 to 1 scale over 280ms on a flat ink backdrop at 40%. Total under 700ms so it never feels like waiting. Colour roles: none.
phone: Same swap at 200ms; with reduced motion switch instantly.
houseRuleCheck: The modal backdrop is a flat ink tone, never a blurred glass layer.

name: Tile grows into a drawer
description: A grid of filled tiles (3 across, each about 440x300 at 1440, photograph or flat colour fill, 16px corners, 24px gaps). On click the tile itself animates width, height and position (FLIP, 1.5s, ease-in-out-expo) into a right-hand drawer 720px wide by the full viewport height; the other tiles drop to 40% brightness through a flat ink scrim (no blur). The tile's fill becomes the drawer's fill, so the colour visibly grows into the panel. Inside the drawer, after the tile has covered 70% of its path, the title (56px), three short paragraphs (18px), one image and one filled pill fade up 80ms apart. Close reverses; the URL keeps the open state. Phone: the tile grows to a full-screen sheet from its own position, with a 56px filled close pill at the bottom.
phone: Tile grows to a full-screen sheet from its own position (1.1s); close pill 56px high at the bottom inside the safe area; reduced motion: crossfade.
houseRuleCheck: No box in a box: drawer content sits directly on the drawer's fill with no inner cards; separation from the page is the scrim, not a shadow or outline; the scrim is flat, not glass.

name: Wipe layer
description: Between pages (or between two big states of a single page) a flat full-screen layer in the accent or the ink covers the screen. It scales on Y from the bottom (origin bottom, 0 to 1 in 500-800ms, cubic-bezier 0.76, 0, 0.2, 1), holds 150ms while the route swaps, then leaves upward (origin top, 1 to 0 in 500-700ms). While it moves the outgoing page shifts up 100px and the incoming page starts 100px low and rises to 0 with opacity 0 to 1 over 700ms. A strip variant uses 4-6 vertical bars staggered 60ms across the width instead of one layer. The layer carries nothing, or one centred word at the h2 step in the ground colour naming the destination. Total 1.2-1.6s; skipped on back navigation and under reduced motion. Phone: the same, timings 15 percent shorter, strips reduced to 3.
phone: Same wipe, 15 percent shorter, three strips.
houseRuleCheck: Clean when flat: a diagonal stroke pattern on the layer would be drawn hairlines and is left out; the layer is one flat colour with a hard edge, no gradient.

name: Circle swap with a turn
description: A stepped slide where each slide is a circular photograph crop (about 560px across at 1440, sitting right of centre) with its caption on the left: a 40px title and a 20px line, max 40 characters wide. On a step (arrow key, click on the filled next pill, or a swipe) the outgoing circle turns to -15deg while shrinking to scale 0.3 and fading as it slides 80px up and out (0.8s); the incoming circle rises from 80px below, turns from 15deg to 0 and grows from 0.3 to 1 (0.9s, ease-out-expo), overlapping by 0.3s. Because the picture rotates inside its circle, the turn reads clearly. Caption lines rise through masks 60ms apart. Ground a flat tint per slide (two or three tints of one hue), ink near-black, accent only on the next pill. No dots, no counter.
phone: Circle 78vw centred above its caption; swipe steps; turn 10deg; reduced motion: crossfade.
houseRuleCheck: A circular photo crop is a mask, not a drawn shape; no ring outline around it, no slide counter or numbered dots.

name: Full-bleed shrinks to frame
description: A pinned stage (100svh, 1.2-2 viewport heights of scroll). A full-screen picture or video at 1440 x 900 scales down, by transform or clip and never by layout, to a centred frame 34-42 percent of the width (about 520 x 640 portrait or 640 x 400 landscape) while its radius grows from 0 to 24px. In the same scroll the ground behind turns from the picture's edge tone to a flat palette colour (a cross-fade of two flat colours, not a gradient), and an h1-step headline of 2-4 words fades in from 0 at 40 percent progress, set on the ground beside or below the frame with a 56px gap. The frame then holds; in an optional second stage it shrinks again to 25 percent while a two-line caption appears. Linear against scroll with 0.1 smoothing. Phone: shrinks to 70 percent of the width, frame 4:5, headline below it. Variant: instead of a centred frame the picture shrinks and slides to the right half (ending about 648x765 at 1440 with a 48px right margin, radius 0 to 12px, optionally rotateY -8deg at mid-way and back), and the ground it uncovers carries a text block on the left half: a 64px headline in two or three lines, a 20px sub and one filled pill, rising 24px with an 80ms stagger.
phone: Shrinks to 70 percent width, 4:5 frame, headline beneath.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The frame is a picture with a radius, not an outlined box; the headline sits on the ground beside it so no text box lies on a photograph; ground changes are flat colours.

name: Grows from small
description: A vertical list of 4-6 rows, each row one photograph (frame 1392x720 at 1440, 16px corners) with its title (88px display) above it. As a row enters, the frame scales from 0.2 to 1.0 about its centre (scrubbed, 0.4s smoothing) between 100% and 55% of the viewport height, so it opens like a window from a thumbnail to full width; the title is fixed in place and unaffected. Inside the frame the image sits at 112% height and drifts 6% vertically as the row passes. A one-line caption (18px) sits bottom-left under the frame. 200px of free space between rows. Large scale range, no pin. Ground flat tint, ink near-black, accent none. Phone: scale 0.5 to 1.0, drift 4%, frame 4:5 full width.
phone: Frame 4:5 full width inside 20px gutters; scale 0.5 to 1.0 and drift 4%; titles at 40px above.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. No numbering on rows; no overlay boxes on the photographs; captions sit on the ground, not on the picture.

name: Inset grows to full bleed
description: A section placed just after the hero, with 160px of clear space above it so the first screen stays the hero alone, pins for 150-200vh. A small inset (25-30% of the viewport width, 4:5 or 16:9, centred, or in the left third with a statement beside it) grows by scrub to cover the whole viewport (width and height to 100vw by 100vh, radius from 24px to 0) while the text beside it fades out by 30% of the progress. The side clips close and then the next section's flat ground rises over it. At full size a one-line 72-120px headline may fade in at the bottom-left directly on the picture. Colour roles: flat ground, the picture is the colour, ink white on the picture.
phone: The inset starts at 70% width 4:5 and grows to 100vw by 100svh; pin 140vh; with reduced motion show the picture at full size with no pin.
houseRuleCheck: It is never the hero itself, because a hero that starts small breaks the full-screen first view; the headline sits directly on the picture with no box and no gradient scrim.

name: Wordmark flies into the frame
description: The nav carries a live-text wordmark (28px). A pinned stage of 300vh holds a centred picture frame (about 640x800 at 1440, 12px corners). Over 900px of scroll a clone of the wordmark travels from the nav's top-left to the frame's centre, growing to 120px as it goes, and over the last 20% of the travel it fades into the picture while the picture scales 1.0 to 1.2 inside its fixed frame. When the pin ends the nav wordmark fades back at 28px. The wordmark sits on the photograph as type only, in white; ground around the frame a flat tint, ink near-black, accent none. Phone: frame full width at 4:5, wordmark 72px, the same travel from the top-left.
phone: Frame full width at 4:5; the clone grows to 72px; if the nav wordmark is hidden on phone the clone starts from the top-left safe area; reduced motion: wordmark fades in place.
houseRuleCheck: The wordmark must be live text in the page's own display face, not a drawn mark or an icon; it appears at 120px mid-page only, never as a giant name in the footer.

name: Pinned stage shrinks
description: A pinned stage (100svh, 0.8-1.2 viewport heights of scroll). The hero's content group (an h1-step headline plus a product panel up to 560 x 380px) scales from 1 down to 0.5-0.8 (origin top centre, with a 8-16px lift) as the next panel rises from the bottom over it: a flat panel in the inverse of the ground (ink or accent) with a 40px top radius. While the group shrinks, one supporting figure grows from 0.9 to 1 and a line of text steps up 24px; a cut-out picture may rise from below the group instead of a panel. Scroll-linked with 0.1 smoothing. The stage unpins once the panel covers the screen. Phone: the group shrinks to 0.7 only, the panel rises over it with 16px margins.
phone: Group shrinks to 0.7, panel rises with 16px margins.
houseRuleCheck: Clean when flat: the rising panel is a flat fill, never a gradient. The product panel stays one frame, not boxes inside boxes.

name: Polygon clip opens
description: A pinned scene of about 900px of scroll, scrubbed. A media block (photo or video) starts as a skewed polygon: clip-path polygon(8% 14%, 100% 0, 92% 86%, 0 100%) on a 573x322 box centred on the stage, rotated -4deg. As the scrub runs it grows through three sizes (573x322, then 900x480, then 1360x560 with 40px side margins) while the polygon's points ease to a plain rectangle and the rotation to 0. The clip-path string is rebuilt from the progress value on every frame (no CSS transition). A headline block above it (64px, two lines) scrolls up 820px and out in the same range. Ground flat paper or ink; the media is the only colour. After the end state the media holds 200px of scroll and releases.
phone: Skew halved (4% offsets), stages 320x200, 340x300, then full width minus 40px at 56svh; rotation limited to -2deg.
houseRuleCheck: The polygon is a mask on the media, not a drawn shape; the end state keeps 40px margins so nothing touches the edge.

name: Rounded tile goes edge
description: A media tile (picture or video, 16:9 or 21:9, 1370px wide at 1440) sits inset 5-10 percent from each side with a 24px radius as the section arrives. Over the next 650-720px of scroll (while it is sticky, or as its top travels from 90 to 30 percent of the viewport) it widens to the full 1440px: clip-path inset(0 5% round 24px) to inset(0 0 round 0), the height holding or growing from 80svh to 100svh.
