The radius eases to 0 so it ends edge to edge. Text for the section starts below the tile after it settles (24px rise, opacity 0 to 1); no caption sits on the picture. Phone: inset 16px with a 20px radius, widening to the full 390 over 60 percent of the scroll distance.
phone: Inset 16px, 20px radius, widens to full width over 60 percent of the distance.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. A picture tile with a radius, no outline, no caption box on the photograph.

name: Zoom-out fade in
description: A section about 120vh tall with a full-bleed photograph (1440x800) behind a heading (120px, left-aligned at 96px from the edge, white). As the section enters (from 100% to 30% of the viewport height) the photograph fades from 0 to 1 and eases from scale 1.2 to 1.0, scrubbed with 0.5s smoothing; the heading stays fixed in front and rises 20px. Only if contrast needs it, one flat ink veil at 25%, never a gradient. After it settles the photograph sits still. Ground around is the page's flat tint; ink white on the photo, accent none. Phone: scale 1.12 to 1.0, heading 56px.
phone: Scale 1.12 to 1.0, heading 56px bottom-left; reduced motion: static photograph.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. The heading is type on the photograph, no box behind it.

name: Shrink, tilt, lift away
description: A pinned gallery stage, 300vh for three or four works. Each work is a picture inside a plain panel (about 520x680 at 1440, paper fill, 12px corners) centred on a flat tinted ground. Per work: the picture shrinks from full-bleed to the panel (scale 1.0 to 0.46 over the first 40% of its slot), then the panel tilts back 15deg on the X axis (perspective 1200px) and lifts away upward, fading, while the next panel arrives from below in the same shape, untilting from -15deg. Titles in 48px swap by a mask rise. Depth comes from the perspective only. Phone: panel 78vw, tilt 10deg, 220vh.
phone: Panel 78vw, tilt 10deg, 220vh pinned; reduced motion: plain stacked panels.
houseRuleCheck: A plain panel with no decorative notch; no shadow under the lifted panel and no outline; the panel is a fill, not a box over a photograph.

name: Slow push-in
description: A hero or slide image (cover fit, inside an overflow-hidden frame) scales slowly once after it appears: 1.0 to 1.08 (or 1.1 settling to 1.0) over 10s with power1.out or cubic-bezier(0.61,1,0.88,1). Only scale and a drift of at most 2% in x or y; put the transform-origin at the subject (for example 32% 40%) rather than the centre. If text sits over the picture, lay one flat 30% ink layer under it. Use on designed, generated or product imagery. Colour roles: none, the picture is the colour. Static under reduced motion.
phone: Same push over 8s, scale 1.06.
houseRuleCheck: No gradient scrim (a flat ink layer only) and no documentary or archive photographs.

name: Subtle grow crossing
description: Every picture in a layout breathes slightly: the image inside a fixed frame (overflow hidden, so the frame never changes) scales from 1.00 as it enters at the bottom to 1.04 as it leaves at the top, linear and scrubbed with 0.2s smoothing. Nothing else moves. Use it under static layouts where other motion would crowd: gallery strips, two-up pictures, card photos. Frames keep their layout sizes (for example 4:5, 696px wide at 1440) and their gaps of 24px. Phone: scale 1.00 to 1.03. Colour roles: ground a flat tint, ink near-black, no accent; the effect needs no extra type or chrome of its own.
phone: Scale 1.00 to 1.03; reduced motion: none.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict; a quiet basic.

name: Title grows as the camera descends
description: A pinned stage of 300vh with a WebGL scene. A centred title in DOM (two words, 139px at the start) scales to 216px (about 1.55x, by transform) while the camera descends from a high view to a low one (its height falling to about a seventh of the start over the pin) above a flat ground plane. Matte flat-colour planes (4-6, like sheets of paper) roll in from the sides and settle as a floor as the camera comes down. Ground = the canvas colour, ink = the title, accent = one plane. No lighting gradient: materials are unlit flat colours, no soft shadows. When the pin ends the stage lifts away at half speed under the next section. Phone: title 84px to 130px, canvas DPR capped at 1.5.
phone: Title 84px growing to 130px; same camera descent with DPR 1.5; without WebGL or under reduced motion show one static render with the title at full size.
houseRuleCheck: The planes are modelled flat colour surfaces, not drawn shapes or an illustration; keep them flat-shaded (no gradient, no shadow at rest) and limit the palette to ground, ink and one accent.

name: Velocity squash
description: A horizontal row of 6-10 tiles (each about 380x480 at 1440, 12px corners, 20px gaps) moves by scroll (a pinned section that maps vertical scroll to translateX) or by a slow auto-drift. Scroll velocity is read each frame and smoothed (lerp 0.1); each tile's scale is 1 minus 0.015 times the clamped velocity (0 to 1), so tiles shrink about 1.5% while the row moves and ease back in about 0.5s (a critically damped spring, stiffness 120, damping 22, no overshoot) when it stops. A near-invisible cue that makes the row feel physical. Tiles are photographs or flat-filled cards; ground flat tint. Phone: touch velocity drives the same squash, tiles 72vw wide.
phone: Tiles 72vw wide, swipe-driven; velocity from the touch gesture; reduced motion: none.
houseRuleCheck: No drag rail, scroll-progress bar or counter alongside the row; tiles are filled or photographic, not outlined.

name: Blur-zoom pulse between slides
description: A full-screen slideshow of 4-6 images on a held stage, about one screen of scroll per slide. When the scroll crosses the next slide's threshold (or an arrow key or the filled next pill is pressed) the current slide's image scales from 1 to 2 and blurs from 0 to 24px over 200ms (ease-in) under a flat ink veil rising from 14% to 25%, while its text fades out; at the midpoint the next image (also at 2x and blurred) swaps in and both reverse to scale 1 and blur 0 over 500ms (ease-out); the title (96px, bottom-left) then rises through a mask. The step plays as a timed move so the pulse reads as a camera thump; the wheel is never captured and the page keeps its native scroll. Colour: ground = the image, ink white, accent none. No dots or counters. Phone: scroll steps it; zoom 1.5, blur 12px.
phone: Native scroll steps it; zoom 1.5 and blur 12px; reduced motion: crossfade.
houseRuleCheck: The veil is a single flat layer, never a gradient; no slide counter or numbered dots; text sits on the image as type only; the steps follow scroll position, with no wheel capture.

name: Alternate side slide
description: Four to six rows, each 1392px wide at 1440, one big tile (560x560, 16px corners, a photograph or a flat fill with a single large word at 96px) and a caption block (title 48px, paragraph 20px at 44 characters, one text link) filling the other half, so no row is empty on the left. Odd rows put the tile on the left, even rows on the right. As a row enters (from 90% to 50% of the viewport height) the tile slides 180px in from its outer side and the caption slides 180px in from the opposite outer side, opacity 0 to 1, scrubbed; at rest both are in place. Ground alternates between two flat tints per row; tile fill from one accent family. 120px between rows. Phone: tile above caption, each slides 40px from alternating sides.
phone: Tile above caption, full width inside 20px gutters; each slides 40px from alternating sides; reduced motion: fade.
houseRuleCheck: The tile holds a photograph or one word, never a digit (no 01/02/03 numbering); no outlined tiles; no row left empty on one side.

name: Side cards fan out
description: A pinned stage of 250vh. Five filled cards (each about 360x480 at 1440, 16px corners, photograph or flat fill) start stacked at the centre; as you scroll the outer four fan outward (the two on the left go to x -400 and rotate -23deg, the two on the right to x +400 and rotate +23deg, all scale 0.76, scrubbed) while the centre card stays upright and full size. A title (120px, two words) wipes in behind the cards through a hard elliptical clip-path (radius from 0 to 120% of the stage width, no feathered edge) between 30% and 80% of the pin. Ground a flat tint, ink near-black, accent only on one card's fill. Phone: three cards, fan to +/-120px at 14deg, title 64px.
phone: Three cards instead of five, fan to +/-120px at 14deg, title 64px; reduced motion: the fanned end state, static.
houseRuleCheck: The ellipse is a hard clip, not a soft gradient mask; cards sit on flat ground, never on a photograph; no shadows between the overlapping cards (separation by their own fills).

name: Scrubbed frame sequence
description: A pinned stage (sticky, 100svh, 200-300vh of scroll) holds a canvas that draws one of 90-180 pre-rendered frames (1600x900 webp, 60-120KB each, cover fit), or a video whose currentTime tracks progress, lerped 0.1 so it glides. The subject is a product turntable, a machine opening, a pour, a growing form, rendered on the page's flat ground colour so it blends with no box. Two or three short beats (40-72px headline, at most 12 words) fade in and out at 20%, 55% and 85% of progress, placed to the left or right of the subject, never over it. Preload the first 20 frames, stream the rest and show frame 0 as the poster. Colour roles: ground = the render's background tone exactly, ink contrasting, accent on the closing button. A product with packaging can tell its unboxing this way: the sealed pack enters from below, tears open at the top, the pieces fly off sideways and the product floats up to the centre while a styled product photograph fades in behind it and a headline of three to five words fades in beside it.
phone: A 4:5 or 9:16 set at 960px wide (about 60 frames), pin 160vh, beats 32-40px below the subject; with reduced motion show the key frame and the beats as static blocks.
houseRuleCheck: Render with no cast shadow or glow on a flat ground (no shadows at rest, no gradient backdrop); text stays beside the subject, never on it.

name: Gooey pill swell
description: Three or four filled pill bars in a centred column 1100px wide, each 96px tall with fully round ends, each holding one feature phrase at 40px (sentence case, a few words). The bars begin as 16px dots clustered at the column's centre and swell in sequence to full width as you scroll (scrubbed over 500px), merging gooily on the way: the group of bare shapes (no text inside) runs through a blur-10 plus colour-matrix threshold filter that fuses neighbours, and the phrases are separate siblings that fade in at 80% of the swell so the type is never blurred. Once every pill has settled the filter is removed so the edges are crisp; it returns in reverse when leaving. Fills use two or three tints of one hue family with near-black ink; ground a flat tint. Phone: pills 64px tall, 28px text, column full width inside 20px gutters.
phone: Pills 64px tall at 28px text inside 20px gutters; the filter dropped on low-power devices (pills simply scale); reduced motion: settled pills.
houseRuleCheck: Pills are filled (never outlined); the SVG filter is a rendering effect on flat shapes, not a drawn illustration, and is removed at rest; type is never filtered.

name: Headline shrinks to the corner
description: A pinned stage of 300vh on a flat near-black or deep-colour ground. A two-word headline set at 200px (about 1300px wide at 1440, white) slides in from the left (x -30vw to 0, opacity 0 to 1) over the first 25% of the pin, then rises from a mid-grey to full white (a brief lift in tone in place of a glow), then blurs 0 to 10px between 30% and 50%, then shrinks (scale 1 to 0.1) and travels to the top-left corner, unblurring, to become a 20px sentence-case line that stays as the section's running title; the content beneath then reveals. Phone: headline 84px in two stacked lines, corner target at 20px from the top-left.
phone: Headline 84px in two stacked lines; corner target at 20px from the top-left; reduced motion: headline already in the corner.
houseRuleCheck: A tone lift instead of a glow (no glow, no shadow, no gradient). The corner line is 20px sentence case, never a tiny uppercase spaced label.

name: Hero exits on scroll
description: During the first screen of scroll the hero's content leaves. The wordmark or headline scales 1 to 0.86 (or shrinks toward the top-left to 0.4x), lifts 80px and fades to 0, while the backdrop (picture, clip or canvas) scales 1 to 1.06 and dims under a flat ink overlay from 0 to 40%. Supporting text and small elements go first (done by 40% of the range), the headline last (60%). The next section's flat ground then arrives from below with a hard edge. The range is 100vh of scroll, scrubbed (lerp 0.1) and reversible. At rest the hero is a full 100svh with nothing of the next section visible. Colour roles: ground = the backdrop, ink white or near-black, accent on the hero button only. Variant for a video hero: the hero is sticky inside a wrapper 720px taller than the screen; the footage scales 1.0 to 1.2 and blurs 0 to 3px (a filter on the video layer only, never on text) under a flat ink veil rising to 35% while the headline and pill fade and lift 60px over the first 400px, then the next section slides over as a flat-ground sheet. On a phone there is no blur.
phone: The same ranges at 0.6x distances; with reduced motion no movement.
houseRuleCheck: The hero still fills the first screen alone at rest, and the overlay is a flat tone, never a gradient.

name: Mask counter-moves
description: A pinned scene of about 2000px, scrubbed. A window (overflow hidden, radius 12px, 520x680 at 1440, sitting right of centre at x 760) holds a taller image (520x1180). As scroll runs the window travels from translateY +250px to -250px while the image inside travels the opposite way, -250px to +250px, so the picture seems nailed to the page while the window slides across it and uncovers new parts. A headline of two lines at 120px on the left half (x 64) drifts against the window at 0.5x, and a 20px caption rises 27px at 70% of the range. After the range the window releases and scrolls away normally. Ground flat tint; ink near black.
phone: Window full width minus 40px, 60svh high, travel +/-120px, caption under it.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict: the headline stays on the left half outside the window, so there is no text box on the photograph.

name: Object follows a path
description: A pinned stage of 400vh on a flat tinted ground. A cut-out product photograph or 3D render with a transparent background (about 220px across at 1440) travels along an invisible smooth curve (a cubic Bezier through four or five waypoints that zigzag across the stage, for example x 22%, 70%, 30%, 75%) as you scroll, turning to the curve's tangent within 12deg. At each waypoint it eases to rest for 15% of the progress while the text block on the opposite side (a 56px title and two lines at 20px) fades up beside it, so no side is ever empty. Nothing is drawn along the route; the object alone shows the way. Phone: a gentle zigzag down the centre, object 140px, text under it.
phone: Zigzag down the centre, object 140px, text beneath the object at each stop; reduced motion: object static beside the first block.
houseRuleCheck: No drawn route (a dashed path would be a drawn line) and no sticker or icon: the traveller is a real cut-out photograph or render and the route is invisible.

name: Object flies to the corner
description: A pinned stage with a product (3D model, frame sequence or cut-out, about 640px wide at 1440, centred) on a flat tinted ground. When the next panel (a full-width flat-ground sheet) rises over it, the product shrinks to 1% over the first 80% of that 700px of scroll while travelling to the bottom-right corner (x +44vw, y +36vh) with a slight roll of 20deg, and lands on the filled buy pill that sits there, which gives one small bump (scale 1.0 to 1.08 to 1.0, 300ms). The sheet then covers the stage. Colour: ground tint, ink near-black, accent on the pill only. Phone: the pill is a sticky bar at the bottom edge, the product flies to its centre.
phone: Sticky buy bar at the bottom edge 56px high; the product flies to its centre; reduced motion: product fades while the sheet covers it.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict; the product must be a real photograph or render, not a drawn illustration; the landing target is a filled pill, not an outlined box.

name: Outgoing blurs back
description: A pinned sequence of 3 to 5 statements, 720px of scroll per stage, on a flat ground. In the last 40% of each stage the outgoing statement lifts (translateY 0 to -120px; up to -448px for a large block), blurs (filter blur 0 to 7px) and fades to 0 while the next stage's frame (a flat ground tile or a full photo) slides up from the bottom and covers it. The incoming statement arrives sharp, 12px low, 400ms. Statements are 56 to 72px, three lines of about 24 characters, centred or left at x 96. Colour roles: ground alternates between two tones, ink flips with it, accent none.
phone: Blur capped at 4px, lift 120px, statement 36 to 44px.
houseRuleCheck: The blur is on text leaving, not a glass surface, and it is gone before the next statement is read; no ghost copy or colour split is left behind.

name: Page shreds into strips
description: A pinned stage of 200vh showing a full-bleed section (a photograph or flat colour, headline 120px). A flat ink bar (full width, 28px tall) sweeps down from the top over the pin, like a shredder head. Everything above the bar is cut into 24 vertical strips (60px wide at 1440), built as clipped copies of the same layer, and each strip falls: translateY to 110vh, rotate +/-3deg, in a random order with 25ms stagger, ease-in 0.7s, revealing the next section's ground beneath. Use once per page, as a strong transition. Phone: 12 strips of 30px, bar 20px, 150vh.
phone: 12 strips of 30px, bar 20px high, 150vh pinned; reduced motion: the next section simply covers the stage.
houseRuleCheck: The bar is a flat filled shape (no outline, no shadow); the strips are slices of real content, not drawn shapes; no torn-paper edges are drawn.

name: Product rises into scene
description: A pinned scene of about 840px, scrubbed, for a product handoff. Stage: a flat colour ground (the scene's own tint), a back layer (a cut-out setting such as a plinth, hand, shelf or stand, 640px wide, moving at 0.5x) and a front layer (foliage or foreground cut-out at 1.2x). The product cut-out (transparent PNG, about 520px tall at 1440) starts below the bottom edge (translateY 110%) and rises into the setting (resting at centre or 60% of the width) over 70% of the range, easing out, while the opening title (88px, two lines) lifts 60px and fades in the first 40%; a new caption (30px, two lines) fades in at 75%. Colour roles: ground = tint, ink = near black, accent = one caption link.
phone: Product 62vw wide, rising over 70svh; one layer fewer; caption below the product.
houseRuleCheck: Cut-outs are designed or generated, not documentary photographs; no boxes on the pictures.

name: Big shape rises over
description: A scrubbed section handover over 720 to 900px of scroll. Section A is pinned. A flat circle (CSS border-radius 50%, 660px at 1440, in the next section's ground colour) starts below the bottom edge, centred, and rises into the screen while scaling 1 to 5 so by the end it floods the viewport and becomes the next section's ground. Section A's text stays above it until the circle passes its baseline, then fades over 20% of the range. Scrub with a 0.12 lerp. Optional: an image or video inside the circle, cover fit. Colour roles: circle = next ground (accent or tint), ink flips on the next section. Variant: the disc emerges at the focal point of a picture section instead of rising from below and widens by a hard clip-path circle to cover the screen over about 840px of scroll, while the picture around it blurs to 14px (the filter on the picture only) and its headline fades; the next headline then rises in through a mask.
phone: Circle 120vw wide, scale to 4, 600px range.
houseRuleCheck: A wavy edge would be a drawn shape and is left out: only a CSS circle is used, as a wipe that ends as the next flat ground, no outline, no gradient.

name: Sheet notch flips
description: A stack of full-width sheets (each about 1440x860, two flat tints alternating, a 72px headline and a short paragraph inside) laid one after another. The top edge of each sheet carries a centred notch (160px wide, 28px deep) cut with clip-path. As the sheet's edge crosses the viewport (from 85% to 35% of the viewport height) the notch interpolates from a raised tab (+28px, the sheet's middle lifts) to a cut-in (-28px), scrubbed. Sheets are separated by the colour change alone. 120px of inner padding. Phone: notch 96x20, sheet min-height 100svh.
phone: Notch 96x20, each sheet at least 100svh tall; reduced motion: notches fixed as cut-ins.
houseRuleCheck: The notch is a clip on the section's own edge, not an illustration; no hairline between sheets, no shadow, no outline.

name: Split headline gap
description: A headline of 2-4 words at the h1 step (140-200px at 1440) is cut into a left half and a right half, both in the same ink, face, weight and size. They start together on one line, 40-60px apart. Over a pin of 0.9-1.2 viewports the halves move horizontally apart by 130-430px each while behind them a media slot opens in the centre (clip inset from 50 percent to 0, or width from 0 to 360px to 1276px) on a layer under the type. Letters of each half arrive from 80px out at 0.95 scaleY with 0.5 scrub smoothing for texture. In the last third the halves leave through the sides (x +-60vw) and fade, so no word stands next to the picture at rest and the picture ends alone. Reverses on the way back up. Phone: the halves become two stacked lines that move up and down around the opening slot.
phone: Two stacked lines move up and down around the opening slot.
houseRuleCheck: Clean with care: a picture inside a headline is banned, so the picture is a layer behind the type, never inline between the words at rest, and the words leave before it settles. Both halves share one style; no accent word.

name: Collapsed stack spreads
description: Four filled pills (each 320x88 at 1440, fully round ends, a 28px phrase in sentence case) begin collapsed on the first pill's position at half scale, then spread as you scroll (scrubbed over 600px) to a staggered diagonal cluster, each offset 180px right and 96px down from the one before (up to 536px of travel from the stack), growing from 0.5 to 1.0. The words inside rise 12px through masks as each pill lands. Fills are three flat tints of the palette with near-black ink; ground a flat tint. The cluster stays as the section's content, with a paragraph (20px, 44 characters) beside it. Phone: spread vertically 0, 72, 144 and 216px.
phone: Pills 64px tall, spread vertically at 0, 72, 144 and 216px; reduced motion: spread state.
houseRuleCheck: Pills are filled, never outlined; no tiny uppercase labels inside them; the cluster is balanced by the paragraph so no row is empty at the left.

name: Titles swap by scale
description: A pinned list of 4 to 7 project or chapter titles, about 650px of scroll per swap, scrubbed. The current title sits at the left (x 64, vertically centred, display face 140px, one line, full ink). The next title grows from scale 0.3 to 1 into that spot from the lower left while the previous one shrinks 1 to 0.2 and slides to a stack at the right edge (48px right margin, titles at 0.2 scale and 70% opacity, 28px apart) that rises 120px per swap. Behind them each title has its own flat ground (a tonal family of one hue, or a full-bleed picture) that wipes up from the bottom over the previous one in the same scrub. Colour roles: ground changes per title within the palette, ink flips by contrast, accent none.
phone: Titles 52px; the previous shrinks into a three-line stack at the top right (scale 0.35); 480px per swap.
houseRuleCheck: Titles are words only: no numerals, indices or counters beside them. The stack keeps a 48px margin, so nothing touches the edge.

name: Stacked scene clip-wipe
description: Four to six full-viewport scenes are stacked and fixed in a pinned stage of 300-500vh. The first sits at rest and each incoming layer wipes up from the bottom by clip-path (inset(100% 0 0 0) to inset(0)) over about one screen of scroll, scrubbed (lerp 0.1), while its inner image counter-shifts 10-15% (translateY 15% to 0) so it feels uncovered rather than slid. Each scene is a full-bleed picture or a flat colour with a 72-140px headline at the bottom-left, rising 24px with the wipe, and a 17px line. Colour roles: scenes bring their own colour, ink white or near-black per scene luminance, accent none.
phone: The same stack at 100svh, wipe over 70vh, headline 40-56px; with reduced motion the scenes are plain full-screen sections.
houseRuleCheck: Text sits directly on pictures with no box; alternate flat-colour scenes with picture scenes so the stack does not read as a heavy block of photographs.

name: Staircase to a line
description: A pinned stage of 200vh on a flat ground. Three words in the display face at 150px start on a descending staircase (word one at x 8%, y 20%; word two at x 30%, y 44%; word three at x 52%, y 68%). Scrubbed, their x and y converge onto one centred baseline (y 50%, gaps 0.3em) so the three stairs become one line, the way a sentence settles; then it holds for 20% while a supporting paragraph (24px, 44 characters) rises beneath it. Ink near-black, no accent, no styling of any single word. Phone: three lines stacked as a staircase (24px steps) that align to a left-aligned stack at 64px.
phone: Three lines in a 24px staircase aligning to a left-aligned stack at 64px; reduced motion: the settled line.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict; no word is styled differently from the others and nothing is numbered.

name: Text chunks cross
description: A centred artwork (a picture about 560x700 at 1440) with a headline split into two chunks (120px, one word or short phrase each) that cross it in opposite directions as you scroll through 100vh: the first chunk travels from x -200 to +200 in front of the picture, the second from x +200 to -200 behind it (the artwork is a cut-out or has a plain edge, so the second chunk reads as passing behind). They begin offset to each side, align in the middle, and part again. Ground flat tint, ink near-black. Phone: travel +/-80px, 64px type, picture 70vw.
phone: Travel +/-80px at 64px type; picture 70vw wide; reduced motion: chunks resting either side of the picture.
houseRuleCheck: Text over a picture is fine as type, but keep it clear of boxes; the picture must be designed or generated, not documentary.

name: Tilted sheet levels
description: A pinned 100svh video hero. The next section, a flat-ground sheet whose top corners are 24px round, rises over it from below, tilted 2deg about its left end at the start, and levels to 0deg as its top edge reaches 20% of the viewport height (scrubbed across 100vh). Meanwhile the video dims from 0 to 30% through a flat ink layer and drifts up 8%. Sheet fill is the page's tint, ink near-black. Phone: tilt 1.2deg, 80vh. Type roles: the hero headline (112px, white, bottom-left, 56px from the edges) lives on the video and fades as the sheet covers it; the sheet opens with a 72px headline at 96px from the left. Colour roles: ground = footage, then the sheet tint; ink white on the video and near-black on the sheet; accent only on the hero pill.
phone: Tilt 1.2deg over 80vh; reduced motion: sheet slides over level.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict; the dimming layer is a single flat ink layer, not a gradient; no shadow on the rising sheet (the colour change defines its edge).

name: Video mosaic halving
description: A split section: a list of five phrases on the left (64px display, 24px gaps, ink at 45% for inactive and full for active) and a 640x640 canvas on the right that draws a playing clip as a mosaic of flat squares sampled from the video. The active step sets the square size, halving per step: 128, 64, 32, 16, 8 pixels, then the clean picture, so the footage comes into focus as you move down the list; cross-fade between sizes in 300ms. Scrub-linked (each step takes 18vh of scroll in a pinned section) or hover-linked on a desktop pointer. Ground near-black, ink white, accent only on the active phrase's fill behind the word. Phone: canvas sticks at the top at 100% wide by 60vw, list below.
phone: Canvas stuck at the top (100% wide, 60vw tall), list below at 40px; step by scroll; reduced motion: the clean picture, list unchanged.
houseRuleCheck: The squares are a rendering of the footage, not drawn shapes; no monospace labels, no counters on the steps; type is the page's own face.

name: Photo window morphs between shapes
description: A split stage: a list of four phrases on the left (56px, 20px gaps, active in full ink, others at 45%) and on the right one photo window (560x560) whose clip-path polygon (six vertices) tweens in 0.6s (ease-out-expo) between four states when the active phrase changes by hover or click: a wide parallelogram, a hexagon-like crop, a tall pentagon and a near-rectangle. At the tween's midpoint the photo swaps (crossfade 0.3s) to the phrase's own picture, and the flat colour behind the window steps through the palette (one tint of the page's hue family per state). Every state is a crop of a photograph, never a standalone filled shape. Phone: the list becomes 40px stacked rows above the window at 80vw.
phone: List as stacked rows above the window (40px type), window at 80vw; tap steps the state; reduced motion: swap without tween.
houseRuleCheck: Each polygon only crops a photograph, never a standalone filled shape (a drawn shape), with no outline and no decoration; if the builder cannot hold a photograph in the window do not use this pattern.

name: Lines tilt in 3D
description: A statement of three to five lines (72-96px at 1440, ink near-black, left-aligned at 96px) in a section with perspective 1200px. Each line sits in its own wrapper and, scrubbed by scroll (from 85% to 40% of the viewport height), goes from rotateY(-55deg), translateZ(-120px), translateY(30px) and opacity 0 to flat, in place and fully visible; each line lags the previous by 8% of the progress, so they hinge open one after the other like pages. Transform-origin left centre. Ground a flat tint. Phone: rotateY -35deg, 40px type.
phone: rotateY -35deg, 40px type; reduced motion: lines fade in only.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict; no word is styled differently from its line.

name: Arc letters pop
description: A short phrase of 14-22 characters set at 72-96px in the display face along a gentle upward arc (radius about 1400px, spanning roughly 40deg, about 900px of chord at 1440). Each letter is its own absolutely positioned span, rotated by its angle on the arc (about -20deg at the left end to +20deg at the right), so the baseline curves. On entry each letter pops in with a 40ms stagger: scale 0.6 to 1.0 and opacity 0 to 1, 0.5s ease-out-expo, with no overshoot. Plays once. The whole phrase is also available as one aria-label and the letters are aria-hidden. Ground a flat colour, ink one colour, accent none. Phone: radius 600px, 44px type, 36deg span.
phone: Radius 600px, 44px type, 36deg span; reduced motion: letters already in place.
houseRuleCheck: Type on a curve is not a drawn shape and no SVG path is shown; positions are computed in script; letters stay live text in the page's own face.

name: Brackets close in
description: A single word or two short words set large as the section's statement (120-180px, display face, ink near-black, centred), flanked by two bracket glyphs from the same face at 1.2x the word's height. On entry the brackets start 300px further out on each side and slide inward (1.0s, ease-out-expo) until they sit 0.2em from the word, while the word fades from 0 to 1 and rises 16px over the second half. After landing everything holds still; a paragraph (22px, 44 characters) sits 56px under it. Ground a flat tint, accent none. Phone: word 72px, brackets travel 120px.
phone: Word 72px, brackets travel 120px; reduced motion: final state.
houseRuleCheck: Never a small bracketed label above a heading (an eyebrow): the brackets are typographic marks around the large statement word itself; the page's own face, never a monospace; brackets stay ink, not a styled accent.

name: Char blur scrub
description: A headline or short statement (h2 step, 14 words at most) set on 2-4 lines and split into characters. It is scroll-linked (0.6 smoothing) over 400-720px of scroll as the block travels from 85 to 40 percent of the viewport: each character moves from opacity 0, blur 4-18px and a 14px sideways offset (or 10px low) to opacity 1, blur 0, offset 0, staggered left to right and line by line so the effect runs like a wave of three to five letters. On the way out the same values reverse, starting when the block passes 20 percent from the top. It is fully crisp before it has to be read. Ink on ground, one type step, no colour change per character. Phone: blur peaks at 8px, splitting limited to 80 characters to protect the frame rate; the parent keeps an aria-label with the whole text.
phone: Blur peaks at 8px, at most 80 split characters, aria-label on the parent.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. No accent word, no coloured letters; the statement is kept to 14 words.

name: Colour wave through the headline
description: A headline of 80-120px in ink on a flat ground. On entry a wave of the accent colour runs through every character from left to right: 30ms stagger per character, each character turns accent over 150ms and eases back to ink over 450ms. The wave covers the whole headline equally, so no word is singled out, and at rest the headline is one plain ink colour. May repeat once on hover or when the section re-enters. Phone: 56px, stagger 20ms. Colour roles: ground a flat colour, ink one value, accent the page's single accent (used only in the wave). The headline is set in one weight and size so the wave is the only event.
phone: 56px, stagger 20ms; reduced motion: plain ink, no wave.
houseRuleCheck: Flashing only the emphasised words would make a styled accent word, so the wave passes through every character equally and ends in plain ink, leaving nothing emphasised at rest.

name: Letter fade stagger
description: Split a headline or statement into characters (aria-label on the parent, spans aria-hidden). Letters fade from 0 to 1 opacity with 30ms between letters, 600ms each, ease-out, no movement and no blur, starting when 40% of the block is in view; total at most 1.2s for up to 40 characters (shorten the stagger for longer text). Use on a calm centred title of 64 to 120px in a single face. Colour roles: ink on ground; no accent. Static under reduced motion.
phone: Same with a 20ms stagger; split by word instead when the line has more than 50 characters.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict; the whole headline fades in one style, with no styled accent word.

name: Words light with the film
description: A split section: a film (a 60-90s edit or a few clips, 720x420, 16px corners, looping, muted with a single filled play/pause pill) on one side and a paragraph (40px display, 12-16 words, 3-5 lines) on the other. The words start at 45% ink opacity and each lights to full ink when the film's currentTime passes its timestamp (an authored array of times); at the loop everything resets to dim. Nothing is driven by scroll. No scrub bar is shown. Ground a flat tint, ink near-black, accent on the pill. Phone: film on top at full width (16:9), paragraph under at 26px.
phone: Film full width on top at 16:9, paragraph under at 26px; reduced motion: all words at full ink and the film paused on a poster.
houseRuleCheck: No on-screen progress bar or timecode; the pill is filled, not outlined; text does not sit on the footage.

name: Beats swap in place
description: A pinned text stage (100svh). A block 560-720px wide at the left third holds one beat at a time: an h2-step headline of 3-8 words and optionally one 18px line. With scroll (about 720px per beat, four to eight beats) the current beat dims to 0.1 opacity and scales to 0.9, or blurs 6px or drops 9px, while the next rises 9-24px from below into the very same spot to full opacity, the two overlapping by 30 percent. A single picture or product panel at the right swaps in step with the beats (clip wipe from the bottom, 600ms) so the right side never sits empty. The ground may step between two flat colours at chosen beats. Phone: the block stays at the top of the upper half, the picture below it, 520px of scroll per beat.
phone: Block above, picture below, 520px of scroll per beat.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. No beat counters, no dots or progress rail tracking the beats, each beat at most 8 words, and the picture keeps the right side filled.

name: Letters drop and unskew
description: A hero word or short title (160-240px, display face, one ink colour) whose letters drop in from above in random order: each letter travels from -60vh to its place with skewX from 70deg to 0 and scale 0.6 to 1.0, 0.9s ease-out-expo, 40ms apart, 1.2s in all, landing on one shared baseline. Triggered on load, once. The letters carry no outline or shadow. Ground a flat colour, accent none. Phone: 96px, drop 40vh. Use it only as a hero title or a closing statement, never as the footer's name. Colour roles: ground a flat colour, ink one value, accent none. Set at normal tracking (-0.02em) so the word does not jump when the last letter lands.
phone: 96px, drop 40vh, same random order; reduced motion: letters already in place.
houseRuleCheck: Used on the hero headline or a closing statement, never a giant name in the footer; no shadow beneath the letters as they land.

name: Letters slide from the side
description: A hero on load. The title (140px, display face, ink) scales from 1.3 to 1.0 over 1.4s (ease-out-expo) while its opacity goes 0 to 1 in the first 40%. 400ms after it starts, a tagline of 24-34 characters at 28px slides in under it, each letter 230px in from the left with a fade, 18ms stagger, 0.9s ease-out-expo, so the line sweeps in like a wave. Both play once. Ground a flat tint or the hero picture; ink near-black or white; accent none. Phone: title 64px, letter slide 120px.
phone: Title 64px, slide 120px, stagger 14ms; reduced motion: fade only.
houseRuleCheck: The tagline is a sentence-case line at 28px, not a tiny uppercase label; nothing sits in a box.

name: Line clip wipe
description: A pinned stage of 250vh on a flat ground with a statement of four to six lines (64-88px at 1440, ink, left-aligned at 96px, about 30 words in all). Each line is wiped in left to right by a hard clip (clip-path inset from 100% on the right to 0), scrubbed by scroll, with each line starting 14% of the progress after the one above and taking 28%. Edges are hard, not feathered. Lines already wiped stay in full ink; the last line is the same ink as the rest. After the final wipe the pin holds for 15% and releases. Phone: 38px type, lines wrap but keep the stagger.
phone: 38px type, wrapped lines keep their stagger (each wrapped line is its own wipe); reduced motion: all lines visible.
houseRuleCheck: The clip edge is hard (no feathered gradient mask); no word in the statement is accented.

name: Line fade-rise
description: Each line of a heading or paragraph rises from below and fades in without a mask. Heading lines rise 30px, body lines 10-14px, opacity 0 to 1 over 800ms on cubic-bezier 0.19, 1, 0.22, 1, lines staggered 80-120ms. It starts when the block's top reaches 85 percent of the viewport and plays once. Lines are split by measuring the real wrapping and re-split on resize, so every line is a unit. There is no clip, so descenders are never cut. Phone: 600ms, 8px, same stagger.
phone: 600ms, 8px rise, same stagger.
houseRuleCheck: Clean.

name: Masked char rise
description: A short display word or phrase (1-4 words, up to 30 characters) is split into characters inside a mask the height of the cap line plus descender. Each character rises from translateY(100-120%) to 0 over 0.8-1.0s, expo-out, characters 25-45ms apart left to right (whole run under 1.2s), once on load or on entry. Size 140-280px at 1440 on one line, leading 0.9, tracking -0.03em, one face and weight, the phrase filling 70-100% of the container width. Optionally each character rotates 8-12 degrees to upright while it rises. Keep an accessible label on the parent so the phrase reads as one string. Colour roles: ink on ground; every character the same colour, accent not used on letters.
phone: Size by width (12-20vw), up to two lines, 20ms stagger; with reduced motion show instantly.
houseRuleCheck: Same colour for all characters, no styled accent word; use for a hero statement or a mid-page phrase, never as a giant name in the footer.

name: Masked line rise
description: A headline or statement is split into lines and each line is wrapped in an overflow-hidden mask the height of its line box (leading 1.0-1.05; give the mask 0.1em extra at the bottom so descenders survive). Each line starts at translateY(110%) and rises to 0 over 0.9-1.1s, ease-out-expo, lines 90-140ms apart, once on load for hero text and on entry (block top at 80% of the viewport) elsewhere. Sizes at 1440: 64-140px, 2-5 lines, sentence case, tracking -0.02em, one face and one weight. A sub line or button fades in 300ms after the last line lands. Split after fonts load and re-split on resize with identical line breaks. Colour roles: ink on ground; the mask is invisible. All lines share one colour and weight.
phone: Re-split at phone width (headline 40-52px, 3-6 lines), stagger 70ms; with reduced motion show the text at once.
houseRuleCheck: No styled accent word: every line has the same colour and weight, so the stagger never singles a word out.

name: Mask roll swap
description: When a state changes (a slide, a tab, a disc, a list item) the text that describes it, a title, a price, a date or a one-to-three-word value at 24-72px, rolls out and the new text rolls in. The old text moves up 100 percent (23px for small type) out of a mask that is exactly one line tall plus 0.1em at the bottom so descenders survive, in 300-420ms on cubic-bezier 0.77, 0, 0.18, 1; the new text enters from below 60ms later, words staggered 30ms. Labels beside it slide 12-23px. If the new title wraps to two lines the container animates its height in the same 300ms. The roll follows the direction of navigation (next goes up, previous goes down). Phone: the same, 260ms.
phone: Same roll, 260ms.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. The mask only clips the text itself; no outlined box around it.

name: Scattered letters assemble
description: A heading of one to three words (96-140px, ink) whose characters begin scattered, each at a fixed pseudo-random offset of 100-200px in x and y and +/-20deg of rotation at 20% opacity, and settle to their places as the section scrolls in (progress from 85% to 40% of the viewport height, scrubbed with 0.5s smoothing). The same seed per character gives the same scatter each visit. The section clips overflow so the scatter stays inside it; 160px of space below for a paragraph that fades in after. Ground a flat tint. Phone: offsets 60px, 56px type.
phone: Offsets 60px, 56px type; reduced motion: assembled.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict; one ink colour, no styled word.

name: Scrubbed character mask rise
description: A headline of one to three words at 120-200px in which every character sits inside a line-height mask. As the section crosses the viewport the letters rise by scroll: each starts 240px below (hidden by the mask) and moves to zero between 85% and 45% of the viewport height, with a stagger of 2% of the progress per character; as the section leaves (from 25% to -5%) the letters sink back down through the mask, again staggered. The word is therefore only fully read in the middle of the screen. Ground a flat tint, ink near-black. Phone: 72px, rise 120px.
phone: 72px, rise 120px, same stagger; reduced motion: letters in place.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict; one colour; the mask is invisible, not a drawn shape.

name: Scroll ink fill
description: A statement of 25-60 words at 36-56px (leading 1.15, max width 1000-1100px, left aligned in the container) rests in ink at 45% opacity, already readable. As it crosses the viewport (block top at 80% to block bottom at 40%) each word goes to 100% ink in reading order, smoothed 0.15. It is not pinned: it scrolls with the page, so the fill finishes as the last line reaches about 45% of the screen height. The section holds 200px of space above and below and nothing else. Colour roles: flat ground, ink, dim ink = ink at 45%. All words use the same fill so none is singled out. Variant: pin the paragraph for 2-3 screens of scroll (36-48px in an 880px column, at most 40 words) so it stays still while the words fill in reading order, word i at progress i/n with a soft edge of about three words; one optional picture at the right scales 0.9 to 1, and the stage releases after the last word has held for 0.3 of a screen.
phone: 26-34px, same word by word mechanism; with reduced motion show full ink at once.
houseRuleCheck: No accent word: the whole paragraph fills in one ink, and the dim state stays readable.

name: Scrubbed line rise
description: The lines of a statement (h2 step, 2-5 lines) start low and transparent and rise with scroll as the block travels from 90 to 50 percent of the viewport: the first line begins 45px low, the second 90px, the third 135px, each at opacity 0, and they reach 0 offset and full opacity one after the other. In a pinned variant they hold, then exit upward to -90px and fade over the next 400px of scroll; a caption line rises 27px. Linear against scroll with 0.1 smoothing, no mask. Phone: the offsets halve.
phone: Offsets halve, same scrub.
houseRuleCheck: Clean.

name: Word cycle with its own photo
description: A two-line headline (96px, ink, left at 96px) whose last word cycles through six words every 2.2s: the old word rolls up through a mask and the new one rises in (0.6s, ease-out-expo). Beside it, at least 64px away and never inside the headline, one photo window (320x400, 16px corners) swaps to the picture for that word at the same moment by a vertical wipe (clip-path inset from the bottom to the top, 0.7s). The cycling word is the same ink and weight as the rest of the line. Pauses on hover. Phone: the photo window sits above the headline at full width by 220px, headline 44px.
phone: Photo window above the headline at full width by 220px, headline 44px; reduced motion: first word only with its photo.
houseRuleCheck: No picture inside the headline: the photo window is separate and spaced from the text; the cycling word is not styled or coloured differently from the rest.

name: Word rise stagger
description: The words of a headline (h1 or h2 step) each rise 40-80 percent of a line height from below while fading from 0 to 1 over 700-900ms (cubic-bezier 0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), staggered 50-70ms per word, playing once. In the hero it starts 200ms after load; elsewhere when the block reaches 85 percent of the viewport. Words are inline-blocks without a mask, so nothing is clipped. Phone: the same, 20 percent faster.
phone: Same, 20 percent faster.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. All words in one style; none picked out in accent.

name: Words tumble in
description: The words of a headline (h1 step, 3-6 words) arrive from different starting states: each from its own offset (up to 40px sideways or vertical), tilt (-27 to +27 degrees) and scale (0.45 to 1.3), the rotation sign alternating per line, all at opacity 0. They settle to exact position, 0 degrees and scale 1 in 900-1100ms on ease-out-expo (no overshoot), staggered 70-110ms in two to five groups, once on entry. The end state is perfectly aligned and crisp. All words keep one colour. Phone: offsets and tilts halve.
phone: Offsets and tilts halve.
houseRuleCheck: Clean. One colour for all words; no accent word; nothing stays tilted at rest.

name: Words zoom through
description: A pinned stage of 400vh on a flat dark ground. Four or five words or short phrases (160px, white, centred) pass through the viewer one after another: each grows from scale 0 and blur 16px to scale 1 and blur 0 over 45% of its slot, holds sharp for 10%, then grows to scale 2.2 with blur rising back to 16px and opacity to 0 over the last 45%, so it flies past. The next word begins as the last leaves, overlapping by 10%. The last word holds and the pin releases onto a paragraph. Phone: 96px, phrases of up to two lines. Variant: a statement of up to 12 words assembles in place instead of flying past: its words arrive from scale 1.3, blur 8px and opacity 0 in a shuffled order across 60% of its window, hold for a quarter of it and leave the same way before the next statement arrives. Split by words, never by characters, so every word reads whole.
phone: 96px, phrases up to two lines, 300vh; reduced motion: words stacked in a normal section.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict; blur applies to the words only and ends at zero; no counter or numbering of the words.

name: Toast with a draining fill
description: A confirmation toast: a filled pill or card (360x72 at 1440, 16px corners, accent fill, ink text at 20px in sentence case, three to six words) drops in from above (from -120px) at 88px from the top, centred under the nav (never over it), settling with no overshoot (500ms, ease-out-expo). It stays about 4s, and during that time its own fill drains: a second flat layer one step lighter covers the whole toast and retracts from the right to the left (clip-path inset, linear, 4s), so the toast itself is the timer and no separate bar exists. Then it scales to 0 (450ms ease-in) toward its centre. It appears only after a user action (added, saved, copied) and one at a time. Phone: full width minus 24px, 12px below the top safe area.
phone: Full width minus 24px, 12px below the top safe area; the same drop and drain; reduced motion: fade in and out.
houseRuleCheck: No countdown bar along an edge (a progress bar and a hairline): the toast's own fill drains, so no bar or rule is drawn, and it does not overshoot. It never sits over the navigation as an announcement bar and carries no sentence beyond a few words.

name: Blurred backdrop echo
description: A 100vh section where one clip plays twice: a full-bleed copy (scaled 1.1, blurred 40px, brightness 60% through a flat ink layer) as the backdrop, and, centred over it, a sharp reel tile (960x540, 20px corners) playing the same clip in sync (the backdrop copy is mirrored to a small canvas to save a second decoder, with a drift correction every second). A headline (88px, white) sits above the tile at 64px from the top and a filled pill below it. The tile is pure media: no caption box, no controls, no frame on it. Phone: the tile is full width minus 24px (16:9), the backdrop fills the rest, headline 44px above.
phone: Tile full width minus 24px at 16:9, backdrop fills the screen, headline 44px above; reduced motion and data saver: a still poster for both.
houseRuleCheck: The tile sits on a blurred copy of itself, so it must carry no UI box, label or border (no boxes on photographs); the veil is flat, not a gradient; use designed or generated footage, not documentary.

name: Hero video loop
description: The hero stage is 100svh and a muted, autoplaying, looping clip (cover fit, 1920x1080, under 3MB, 6-20s, poster = its first frame) fills it, with nothing of the next section visible. Footage is motion graphics, product macros, abstract material or rendered scenes, not documentary footage; for a clip with cuts use 3-5 shots of 2-4s. Over it: a headline of 80-140px at the bottom-left, 40px from the edges, white; a 20px sub at max 40 characters; one filled pill to its right. If text needs help, use a flat ink veil at 20-35%, never a gradient. A sentence-case 16px Pause text control sits bottom-right at 32px. Colour roles: ground = the footage, ink white or near-black, accent = the button fill only.
phone: Serve a 720x1280 crop, or only the poster on data saver; headline 44-56px at the bottom, button full width; playsinline autoplay; with reduced motion show the poster.
houseRuleCheck: No gradient scrim (flat veil only), no documentary footage, and text sits directly on the footage with no box.

name: Poster with a play button
description: A film block: a poster frame (16:9, 960x540 at 1440, 16px corners) with a filled pill button centred on it (56px high, 32px side padding, accent fill, ink text at 18px reading the word Play and the length), not a ring. On hover the pill scales to 1.06 and the poster 1.03 (0.4s); on click the poster fades in 0.4s, the clip starts with sound and the pill disappears; native controls appear after. Nothing else is on the poster. Phone: poster full width inside 20px gutters, the pill 56px high, no autoplay.
phone: Poster full width inside 20px gutters, pill 56px high, tap starts playback with sound, no autoplay; reduced motion: same, no hover scale.
houseRuleCheck: A filled pill, never a play ring (an outlined shape); no icon-only glyph; the pill is a control on a picture, not a card on a photograph.

name: Autoplay video tiles
description: A grid of 4-9 tiles (3 columns by 2 rows of 410x520 at 1440, 32px gap, radius 0-16px) in which each tile's picture is a muted looping clip (6-10s, 720p, 600-900KB, poster = first frame). A clip plays only while at least 50% visible and pauses otherwise, with at most three playing at once. Under each picture sits a 24px title and a 17px line, the picture and its caption forming one filled card (fill 5% off the ground). Hover raises the caption fill by one tone step; no shadow. Colour roles: flat ground, card fill, ink, accent on a closing link.
phone: One column of 85vw tiles in a native snap row, clips play at 60% visible and only on wifi, posters otherwise; with reduced motion show posters.
houseRuleCheck: Captions sit on the card beneath each clip, never on the footage; footage must not look documentary.
